item.title: Park Chan-dae campaign reports Yoo Jeong-bok to police over suspected omission of virtual assets (박찬대 후보 캠프, ‘가상자산 신고 누락 의혹’ 유정복 후보 경찰에 고발)
item.description:
Park Chan-dae campaign reports Yoo Jeong-bok to police over suspected omission of virtual assets (박찬대 후보 캠프, ‘가상자산 신고 누락 의혹’ 유정복 후보 경찰에 고발)

<<>> The campaign of Democratic Party of Korea’s Incheon mayoral candidate Park Chan-dae announced on the 22nd that it had reported People Power Party’s Incheon mayoral candidate Yoo Jeong-bok and Yoo’s wife, Mrs. Choi, to the police on charges of violating the Public Official Election Act and the Public Service Ethics Act. ()

The Park Chan-dae campaign stated, “We have clearly confirmed live voice recordings where Candidate Yoo’s spouse conspired with virtual asset managers to conceal assets,” and added, “If they try to play dumb in the face of clear criminal evidence, it is a grave misconception.” (더불어민주당 박찬대 인천시장 후보 캠프는 공직선거법과 공직자윤리법 위반 등 혐의로 국민의힘 유정복 인천시장 후보와 유 후보의 아내 최모씨를 경찰에 고발했다고 22일 밝혔다.)

The campaign continued, “The Yoo camp is brandishing an elder brother’s affidavit and bank transaction records, making excuses that ‘it was an investment made on behalf of the brother’s money.’ This has nothing to do with uncovering the truth and only adds to the criminal charges.” (박찬대 후보 캠프는 “유 후보 배우자가 가상 자산 관리인들과 은닉을 모의하는 생생한 육성 녹음까지 똑똑히 확인했다”며 “명백한 범죄 증거 앞에서 오리발을 내밀며 넘어가려 했다면 크나큰 착각”이라고 했다.)

The Park campaign further claimed, “Hundreds of millions of won were exchanged, but there isn’t a single legally binding loan agreement. If such large sums were transferred without a loan agreement, it constitutes evasion of gift tax, and if someone else’s funds were handled under the spouse’s name, it violates the Financial Real Name Act.” (이어 “유 후보 측은 형님의 진술서와 통장 거래 내용을 꺼내 들며 ‘형님의 돈을 대신 투자해 준 것’이라는 변명을 늘어놓고 있다”며 “이는 진실 규명과 아무 관련이 없고 범죄 혐의를 더할 뿐”이라고 했다.)

On the 19th, the Park campaign raised suspicions that Yoo had omitted 21,000 virtual assets (worth approximately 100 million won) belonging to his spouse from his candidate asset declaration, and has since intensified its offensive by releasing related recordings and other materials. (박 후보 캠프는 또 “수억 원이 오갔는데, 법적 효력이 있는 차용증 한 장 없다”며 “차용증 없이 억대 돈을 주고받았다면 증여세 탈루이고, 타인의 자금을 배우자 명의로 굴렸다면 금융실명법 위반”이라고 주장했다.)

In response, the Yoo campaign explained, “Candidate Yoo’s spouse simply managed virtual assets purchased with the elder brother’s money,” and stated that they believed it was not subject to asset declaration, while also indicating they would take legal action. (박 후보 캠프는 지난 19일 유 후보가 배우자의 가상자산 2만1000개(1억원 상당)를 후보자 재산에서 누락했다는 의혹을 제기한 데 이어, 관련 녹취록 등을 공개하며 공세 수위를 높이고 있다.)

item.title: Chinese Ambassador "President Lee Criticizes Fake News Stoking Anti-China Sentiment... Highly Praised" (중국대사 “李대통령, 혐중 부추기는 가짜뉴스 비판... 높이 평가”)
item.description:
Chinese Ambassador "President Lee Criticizes Fake News Stoking Anti-China Sentiment... Highly Praised" (중국대사 “李대통령, 혐중 부추기는 가짜뉴스 비판... 높이 평가”)

Chinese Ambassador to South Korea, Dai Bing, said on the 22nd, "I highly commend President Lee Jae-myung for posting on social media yesterday criticizing some South Korean media for creating fake news and stoking anti-China sentiment." (다이빙 주한 중국 대사는 22일 “이재명 대통령께서 어제 SNS에 글을 올려 일부 한국 언론이 가짜뉴스를 만들고 중국 혐오 정서를 부추기는 것을 비판하신 데 대해 높이 평가한다”고 했다.)

Ambassador Dai posted on X (formerly Twitter) that day, stating, "I hope that figures from all walks of life in South Korea can clearly distinguish right from wrong and voluntarily reject fake news, discrimination, and inflammatory public opinion manipulation, thereby enhancing the friendly sentiments between the people of China and South Korea." (다이 대사는 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 “한국 각계 인사들이 시비를 잘 가리고, 가짜뉴스와 차별, 선동적 여론몰이 등을 자발적으로 배격해 중한 양국 국민 간의 우호 감정을 증진시키기를 기대한다”고 했다.)

In another post, Ambassador Dai said, "Over the past period, a small number of South Korean media outlets have fabricated and spread fake news about China to attract attention, boost viewership, or for unspeakable political purposes," adding, "Some media have publicly apologized under pressure, but there are still media outlets zealously producing false reports and commentary related to China." (다이 대사는 또 다른 게시글에선 “지난 한동안 한국 소수 언론은 이목을 끌고 조회수를 올리기 위해, 혹은 말 못할 정치적 목적에서 중국에 관한 가짜뉴스를 날조하고 유포해 왔다”며 “일부 언론은 압력을 받아 공개 사과했지만, 여전히 중국 관련 허위 보도와 논평에 열을 올리는 언론도 있다”고 했다.)

President Lee criticized an article on X the previous day titled "Chinese Rush to Buy 944 Apartments in Gangnam? ... 'Sweeping Up Units Dumped by Multiple Homeowners,'" calling it "apparently fake news intentionally created to be used as material to stoke anti-China sentiment." (이 대통령은 전날 X에 ‘중국인, 강남 아파트 944채 기습 매수?... “다주택자 던진 물량 싹쓸이”’라는 기사를 두고 “혐중(중국혐오) 선동 재료로 사용될 수 있게 의도적으로 만든 가짜뉴스로 추정된다”고 비판했다.)

Earlier, on the 15th, the media outlet reported that just before the resumption of heavy transfer taxes on multiple homeowners, Chinese buyers had concentratedly purchased units put up for sale by multiple homeowners in Gangnam, Songpa, and Yongsan. However, after the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport refuted this, the article was deleted. The ministry countered that among foreign buyers (592 people) who applied for ownership transfer registration to purchase collective buildings in Seoul from January to April this year, 218 were Chinese, and only five Chinese bought collective buildings in Gangnam-gu. (앞서 해당 매체는 지난 15일 다주택자 양도세 중과 재개 직전 강남과 송파, 용산 등에서 다주택자가 내놓은 물량을 중국인들이 집중 매수했다는 취지로 보도했다가 국토교통부가 이를 반박하자 기사를 삭제했다. 국토부는 올해 1∼4월 서울시에서 집합건물 매수를 위해 소유권 이전 등기를 신청한 외국인 매수인(592명) 중 중국인은 218명이었고, 강남구에서 집합건물을 매수한 중국인은 5명에 불과했다고 반박했다.)

President Lee also criticized the report during a Cabinet meeting the previous day, saying, "They are doing this deliberately to incite anti-China sentiment and such." (이 대통령은 전날 국무회의에서도 이 보도를 비판하며 “중국 혐오증 이런 것을 유발하려고 일부러 그러는 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Yong-nam, on Bruised Cho Kuk: "Was He So Envious of Blue That He Made His Face Bruise Purple?" (김용남, 멍든 조국에 “파란색 부러워 얼굴 시퍼렇게 만들었나”)
item.description:
Kim Yong-nam, on Bruised Cho Kuk: "Was He So Envious of Blue That He Made His Face Bruise Purple?" (김용남, 멍든 조국에 “파란색 부러워 얼굴 시퍼렇게 만들었나”)

The five-way race in the Pyeongtaek-eul by-election is intensifying, with tensions rising between Kim Yong-nam, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate, and Cho Kuk, the Cho Kuk Innovation Party candidate. (5자 구도로 치러지고 있는 경기 평택을 재선거에서 김용남 더불어민주당 후보와 조국 조국혁신당 후보 간의 신경전이 거세지고 있다.)

The Pyeongtaek-eul election is a five-way contest featuring Kim, Cho, as well as Yoo Ui-dong from the People Power Party, Kim Jae-yeon from the Progressive Party, and Hwang Kyo-ahn from the Liberty and Innovation Party. Recent polls show a tight race among Kim, Yoo, and Cho. With the gaps between the three candidates narrow, any one of them could take the lead by forming a unification. However, the sparring between Kim and Cho, which has escalated into personal attacks and dredging up past controversies, has stalled any progress on unification discussions. <<> On the 21st, during a campaign speech, Kim targeted Cho, saying, “Was he so envious of the blue color that he made his face turn purple?” This was a sarcastic jab at Cho’s recent appearance with a bruise around his right eye after hitting a glass door, likening it to the Democratic Party’s symbolic color, blue. <<> Cho had previously released a photo of his bruise on the 13th, stating, “During yesterday’s schedule, I had a minor accident hitting my forehead hard against a door. When I woke up, my eyelid was swollen and bruised.” An official from the Cho Kuk Innovation Party expressed displeasure, saying, “Making fun of a candidate’s injury is an over-the-top remark.” <<> Earlier, Cho had repeatedly demanded explanations from Kim, referring to Kim’s past statements as a former member of conservative parties like the Saenuri Party. Kim had labeled this as “negative campaigning” and refused to respond, but recently, Kim seems to have intensified his attacks on Cho. <<> Cho’s camp has raised questions about past allegations that Kim assaulted his staff. During Kim’s first term as a lawmaker, a former aide claimed in a recent media interview, “At a district event in 2015, Kim kicked my shin hard with his dress shoe for being unprepared.” Kim expressed his apologies but denied the assault. In response, the Cho Kuk Innovation Party issued a statement the previous day, saying, “Kim’s denial of assaulting his aide constitutes making false statements under the Public Official Election Act.” <<> Cho’s camp also criticized Kim for his past defense of sexual violence cases. Recently, women’s groups released a statement, saying, “It has been reported that Kim defended over 30 perpetrators of sexual violence,” and added, “The Democratic Party has failed to properly vet its candidate.” (평택을 선거는 김, 조 후보를 비롯해 국민의힘 유의동, 진보당 김재연, 자유와혁신 황교안 후보 등 5자 구도로 치러지고 있다. 최근 여론조사에서 김 후보와 유 후보, 조 후보 간 접전이 벌어지고 있다. 세 후보 간 격차가 근소해 어느 한 후보라도 단일화를 이뤄내면 선두가 될 수 있다. 하지만 김용남·조국 두 후보 간 신경전이 인신공격성 발언과 과거 의혹 들추기 등으로 이어지면서 단일화 논의는 진전이 없는 상황이다.)

item.title: Oh Se-hoon: "Jeong Won-oh Exposed as Incompetent and Corrupt"... Visits Site of 'Jeong's Shrine Controversy' (오세훈 “정원오, 무능·부패 드러나”... ‘鄭 아기씨 굿당 의혹’ 현장 방문)
item.description:
Oh Se-hoon: "Jeong Won-oh Exposed as Incompetent and Corrupt"... Visits Site of 'Jeong's Shrine Controversy' (오세훈 “정원오, 무능·부패 드러나”... ‘鄭 아기씨 굿당 의혹’ 현장 방문)

On the 22nd, People Power Party candidate for Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon conducted intensive campaigning in the so-called 'Han River Belt'—the fiercely contested districts of Dongjak, Gwangjin, Seongdong, Yongsan, and Mapo in this Seoul mayoral election—while leveraging real estate issues to launch attacks against Democratic Party candidate Jeong Won-oh. (국민의힘 오세훈 서울시장 후보는 22일 이번 서울시장 선거 격전지로 꼽히는 동작·광진·성동·용산·마포 등 이른바 ‘한강벨트’에서 집중 유세를 하면서, 부동산 이슈를 앞세워 더불어민주당 정원오 후보를 향한 공세를 펼쳤다.)

Candidate Oh greeted citizens at Boramae Park in Dongjak-gu that morning before visiting Dong Seoul Terminal in Gwangjin-gu and the Konkuk University campus area. Oh stated, "Dong Seoul Terminal will become a key area transforming Gwangjin into a completely new landscape, and the Han River bus departing from Ttukseom will be a boon for Gwangjin," adding, "The Democratic Party doesn't just envy when things go well; they hinder progress." (오세훈 후보는 이날 동작구 보라매공원에서 시민들과 만나 아침 인사를 한 뒤 광진구 동서울터미널, 건국대 대학가 등을 찾았다. 오 후보는 “동서울터미널이 광진을 상전벽해로 만드는 핵심 지역이 될 것이고, 뚝섬에서 출발하는 한강버스가 광진의 효자”라며 “민주당은 잘될 것 같으면 시샘하는 데 그치는 게 아니라 일이 안 되게 방해할 것”이라고 말했다.)

Oh continued, "When I entered Seoul City Hall, I found dozens of people from civic groups who were clinging to and living off former Seoul Mayor Park Won-soon," and warned, "If Candidate Jeong Won-oh gets elected, it could become 'Park Won-soon Season 2,' ruining Seoul." (이어 오 후보는 “서울시에 들어가 보니 박원순 전 서울시장 주변에 붙어먹고 사는 시민단체 출신이 수십 명이었다”며 “혹시 정원오 후보가 당선되면 ‘박원순 시즌2’가 돼 서울시를 말아 먹을 것”이라고 했다.)

Explaining his focus on the Han River Belt, Oh told reporters, "On the second day of the campaign, it's necessary to tour the Han River Belt and more strongly convey to Seoul citizens my commitment to housing supply." He added, "Citizens are suffering from the 'triple surge' in real estate—jeonse, monthly rent, and sale prices. The solution is 'supply without delay.' We need to boost housing supply in the Han River Belt." (오 후보는 이날 기자들과 만나 한강벨트 집중 유세를 펼치는 이유에 대해 “선거 운동 두 번째 날인 오늘 한강벨트를 돌며 서울시민께 주택 공급 의지를 보다 강하게 알리는 게 필요하다”고 말했다. 그는 “부동산 전세·월세·매매 ‘트리플 강세’로 시민들이 고통받고 있다”며 “해법은 ‘닥치고 공급’이다. 한강벨트에 주거 공급을 많이 하는 것”이라고 했다.)

Oh noted, "Over the past five years, many redevelopment and reconstruction zones have been designated. Even if things proceed naturally, the volume ready for groundbreaking totals 310,000 units by 2031, of which two-thirds—198,000 units—are concentrated in the Han River Belt." (그러면서 “지난 5년간 재개발·재건축 구역 지정을 많이 해왔는데, 자연스럽게 진행만 돼도 착공 가능한 물량이 2031년까지 31만호이며, 그중 3분의 2인 19만8000호가 한강벨트에 몰려 있다”고 했다.)

Responding to a query about recent polls showing a narrowing gap with Jeong, who had led early on, Oh said, "Justice will prevail," adding, "Jeong's incompetence, irresponsibility, and corruption are becoming clearer over time." (오 후보는 선거 초반 밀리던 정 후보와의 지지율 격차가 최근 여론조사에서 접전 양상을 보이고 있다는 질의에 “사필귀정”이라며 “정 후보의 무능과 무책임, 부패한 면모가 시간이 흐르면서 밝혀지고 있다”고 답했다.)

That afternoon, Oh also attended the 'On-Site Meeting with Victims of the Shrine Incident' at Haengdang 7 District in Seongdong-gu. The 'Shrine Controversy' involves allegations that during his tenure as Seongdong-gu District Chief, Jeong had arranged for the donation of ownership rights to a newly built 4.8 billion won shrine building as part of the Haengdang 7 redevelopment project, but later demanded cash donations instead of accepting ownership after the shrine's completion, causing losses to the redevelopment union. The People Power Party claims Jeong granted preferential treatment to the shrine entity. <<> At the meeting, Oh asserted, "This controversy is a prime example of Candidate Jeong Won-oh's incompetence and irresponsible administration, a typical three-part package of Seongdong-style corruption cartel," warning, "If Jeong is elected, a second and third such controversy will erupt at redevelopment sites across Seoul." (또 오 후보는 이날 오후 서울 성동구 행당7구역에서 열린 ‘아기씨 굿당 피해주민 현장 간담회’에도 참석했다. ‘아기씨 굿당 의혹’은 정 후보가 성동구청장 재임 시절 행당 7구역 재개발 사업 추진 과정에서 48억원 규모의 굿당 건물을 새로 지을 경우 이 신축 건물의 소유권을 기부채납 받기로 해놓고, 이후 굿당이 완공되자 소유권을 넘겨받지 않고 현금으로 기부채납을 요구해 재개발 조합 측에 피해를 줬다는 의혹이다. 국민의힘은 당시 정 후보가 굿당 측에 특혜를 줬다고 주장하고 있다.)

Oh repeatedly called for additional debates with Jeong, asking, "Isn't he afraid of his corruption, incompetence, and irresponsibility being exposed in a debate? If not, he should agree to a debate immediately." In this election, due to Jeong's refusal, only one legally mandated TV debate for Seoul mayoral candidates is scheduled, prompting Oh to pressure for more. (이 자리에서 오 후보는 “이 의혹은 정원오 후보의 무능과 무책임 행정의 표본이자 전형적인 성동판 부패 카르텔 3종 세트”라며 “(정 후보가 당선된다면) 서울 전역 재개발 사업장에서 제2, 제3의 의혹이 속출할 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Government to Raise Lane Paint Standards to 'Clearly Visible Even on Rainy Nights' (정부, 차선 도색 기준 ‘비 내리는 밤에도 잘 보이게’ 높인다)
item.description:
Government to Raise Lane Paint Standards to 'Clearly Visible Even on Rainy Nights' (정부, 차선 도색 기준 ‘비 내리는 밤에도 잘 보이게’ 높인다)

The government will strengthen the performance standards for road markings such as lane lines, requiring them to be "clearly visible to drivers on rainy nights." (정부가 차선 등 노면 표시의 성능 기준을 ‘비 내리는 밤길 운전자에게도 잘 보일 것’을 요건으로 하도록 강화한다.)

The Government Performance Evaluation Committee under the Office for Government Policy Coordination announced on the 22nd that it has finalized the "Road Safety Enhancement Measures through Improved Road Marking Quality" reported by the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and the National Police Agency. (국무조정실 정부업무평가위원회는 국토교통부와 경찰청 등이 보고한 ‘노면 표시 품질 개선을 통한 도로 안전 강화 대책’을 확정했다고 22일 밝혔다.)

Current performance standards simply measure performance when the road is wet. The National Police Agency has decided to tighten the standards to measure performance during continuous nighttime rain. Additionally, provisions will be established to allow the application of higher standards in accident-prone areas. (현행 성능 기준은 단순히 길이 젖어 있는 상태에서의 성능을 측정하도록 하고 있다. 경찰청은 비가 계속 내리는 밤 상황에서 성능을 측정하도록 기준을 강화하기로 했다. 또 사고 다발 지역에서는 더 높은 기준을 적용할 수 있도록 하는 근거 조항을 마련하기로 했다.)

Meanwhile, provincial police agencies will form joint inspection teams with local governments to annually review the performance of existing road markings. The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and other road management authorities, including local governments, will carry out maintenance and repairs based on the inspection results. (한편 시·도 경찰청은 지방자치단체와 합동으로 점검단을 구성해 매년 기존 노면 표시의 성능을 점검하고, 국토부와 지자체 등 각 도로 관리 주체는 점검 결과에 따라 유지·보수를 하기로 했다.)

To prevent poor construction of road markings, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport will guide local governments to select contractors with proven construction capabilities and strengthen crackdowns on illegal subcontracting at construction sites. (국토부는 노면 표시 부실 시공 방지를 위해 각 지자체가 실질적인 시공 능력을 갖춘 업체를 시공 업체로 선정하도록 안내하고, 불법 하도급 현장 단속을 강화하기로 했다.)

The Office for Government Policy Coordination stated, "With the increase in localized heavy rainfall due to recent climate anomalies, this measure strengthens performance standards to ensure road lanes are clearly visible even while driving on rainy nights, in order to protect the lives and safety of the public." It added, "We will regularly check the implementation status of relevant agencies so that the public can quickly feel the results of the new measures." <<>> (국조실은 “최근 이상 기후로 국지성 집중호우가 빈번해진 가운데, 국민의 생명과 안전을 보호하기 위해 비 오는 밤길 운전 시에도 도로 차선이 잘 보이도록 성능 기준을 강화하는 것”이라며 “새로운 대책의 추진 결과를 국민이 빠르게 체감할 수 있도록 관련 기관의 이행 상황을 주기적으로 점검하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Blue House: "National Growth Fund's Popularity May Lead to Early Sellout of Some Financial Firms' Allocations" (靑 “국민성장펀드 흥행으로 일부 금융사 물량 조기 소진될 수도”)
item.description:
Blue House: "National Growth Fund's Popularity May Lead to Early Sellout of Some Financial Firms' Allocations" (靑 “국민성장펀드 흥행으로 일부 금융사 물량 조기 소진될 수도”)

The Blue House announced on the 22nd that the "Citizen-Participatory National Growth Fund," launched that day, "is rapidly being sold, centered on online channels, amid fervent public interest." It added that due to a flood of subscribers on the first day, some financial companies' allocated volumes may be exhausted early. (청와대는 22일 출시된 ‘국민참여형 국민성장펀드’가 “국민들의 뜨거운 관심 속에 온라인을 중심으로 빠르게 판매되고 있다”고 밝혔다. 첫날부터 가입자가 몰리면서 일부 금융회사의 배정 물량이 조기에 소진될 수 있다고도 했다.)

According to the Financial Services Commission, the total individual sales amount of this National Growth Fund is 600 billion won, with sales starting on a first-come, first-served basis through online and offline branches of 25 major banks and securities firms starting that day. It is a policy fund that invests in advanced strategic industries requiring large-scale investment, such as artificial intelligence (AI), semiconductors, secondary batteries, and biotechnology, designed with the aim of allowing citizens to directly invest in and share the fruits of the nation's future growth engines. (금융위원회에 따르면 이번 국민성장펀드의 개인 판매액은 총 6000억원 규모로, 이날부터 주요 은행과 증권사 25곳의 온·오프라인 영업점을 통해 선착순 판매에 돌입했다. 인공지능(AI), 반도체, 이차전지, 바이오 등 대규모 투자가 필요한 첨단전략산업에 투자하는 정책 펀드로, 국가 미래 성장동력에 국민이 직접 투자하고 성과를 나눈다는 취지로 기획됐다.)

With applications flooding in from the morning, primarily from users familiar with the online environment, offline counter subscriptions for digitally vulnerable groups are also ongoing. Of the total 600 billion won, 120 billion won has been allocated exclusively for low-income individuals, with priority subscription benefits offered for the first two weeks. (온라인 환경에 익숙한 가입자들을 중심으로 오전부터 신청이 폭주한 가운데, 디지털 취약계층을 위한 오프라인 창구 가입도 함께 진행 중이다. 총 6000억원 중 1200억원은 서민 전용으로 배정되어 초기 2주간 우선 가입 혜택이 주어진다.)

Behind the frenzy of first-come, first-served subscriptions from the first day are the exceptional incentives put forward by the government. If subscribers maintain their eligibility for three years through a dedicated National Growth Fund account, they can receive income tax deductions of up to 40% (up to a limit of 18 million won) depending on the investment amount. Additionally, benefits from separate taxation of dividend income (9.9%) are included. (이번 펀드가 첫날부터 선착순 모집에 불이 붙은 배경에는 정부가 내건 파격적인 인센티브가 자리 잡고 있다. 국민성장펀드 전용 계좌를 통해 가입한 뒤 3년간 자격을 유지하면 투자 금액에 따라 최대 40%(1800만원 한도)까지 소득공제 혜택을 받을 수 있다. 여기에 배당소득 분리과세(9.9%) 혜택도 더해진다.)

A key factor that lowered the psychological barriers for investors, in particular, is the "government's loss-bearing mechanism." Policy financial institutions invest in a subordinated position, so if an investment loss occurs, the government and policy financial institutions are designed to absorb the first 20% of downside risk. As news spreads that a partial principal protection effect can be practically expected, liquid funds from the market are rapidly flowing in. (특히 투자자들의 심리적 장벽을 낮춘 핵심 요인은 ‘정부의 손실 부담 장치’다. 정책금융 기관이 후순위로 출자해 투자 손실이 발생할 경우 하방 20%까지는 정부와 정책금융이 먼저 손실을 떠안도록 설계됐다. 사실상 일부 원금 보전 효과를 기대할 수 있다는 소식이 퍼지면서 시중 유동 자금이 빠르게 유입되고 있다.)

However, along with the exceptional benefits, there are clear conditions to be mindful of when investing. This product is designed as a closed-end product with a five-year maturity, making "early redemption" fundamentally impossible during the operation period. If subscribers transfer or cancel within three years due to financial circumstances, the tax benefits received up to that point may be reclaimed, so it should be approached with funds available for long-term investment. (다만 파격적인 혜택만큼 투자 시 유의해야 할 조건도 명확하다. 해당 상품은 만기 5년의 폐쇄형 상품으로 설계되어 운용 기간 중 ‘중도 환매’가 원천적으로 불가능하다. 만약 자금 사정으로 3년 이내에 중도 양도하거나 해지할 경우 그동안 받았던 세제 혜택이 추징될 수 있어 장기 투자가 가능한 자금으로 접근해야 한다.)

A Blue House official stated, "The National Growth Fund can also be subscribed to at offline branches and is scheduled to be sold for the next three weeks, but some financial companies' sales volumes may be exhausted early." (청와대 관계자는 “국민성장펀드는 오프라인 지점에서도 가입할 수 있으며 향후 3주간 판매될 예정이나, 일부 금융회사의 판매 물량은 일찍 소진될 가능성도 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: Jeong Won-oh: "Oh Se-hoon must go directly to the GTX site with missing rebar" (정원오 “오세훈, 철근 누락 GTX 현장 직접 가야”)
item.description:
Jeong Won-oh: "Oh Se-hoon must go directly to the GTX site with missing rebar" (정원오 “오세훈, 철근 누락 GTX 현장 직접 가야” )

Jeong Won-oh, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Seoul mayor, said on the 22nd, "(Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate for Seoul mayor) should currently be going to the site to inspect directly and devise measures." This came after Oh proposed a single debate on the issue of missing rebar at the Samsung Station on the Great Train Express (GTX)-A line. In response, Jeong said, "Don't turn safety into a political battleground." (정원오 더불어민주당 서울시장 후보는 22일 “(오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보가) 현재 할 일은 현장에 가서 직접 살피고 대책을 강구하는 것”이라고 했다. 앞서 오 후보는 수도권 광역급행철도(GTX)-A 삼성역 철근 누락 문제를 두고 단일 토론을 제안했었다. 정 후보는 이에 대해 “안전을 정쟁 소재로 삼지 말라”고 했다.)

After attending the '10th Anniversary Memorial Ceremony for the Industrial Accident Fatality at Guui Station and the Seoul Mayor Candidate Life Safety Pledge Event' held in Gwangjin-gu, Seoul, on the same day, Jeong stated, "Oh seems to try to escape by politicizing his own mistakes or errors whenever they occur. In the past, when concerns were raised over the Jongmyo development issue, he tried to deflect by proposing a debate with the prime minister, politicizing the matter. It's the same this time." He added, "I'm curious why he didn't attend such an important life safety pledge event." <<> The Seoul mayor candidate life safety pledge event, held alongside the memorial, was attended by Jeong and Kwon Young-guk, the Justice Party candidate for Seoul mayor. Oh did not attend. Jeong said, "Protecting the lives and safety of citizens is the mayor's top priority." <<> Jeong began his day by visiting platform 9-4 of Guui Station in Gwangjin-gu, Seoul, wearing a black suit. Ten years ago, on May 28, 2016, Kim, a non-regular worker employed by an outsourced company, was struck and killed by an electric train while repairing a screen door alone. Standing before the platform, Jeong held a chrysanthemum and bowed his head for 30 seconds to honor the deceased. <<> Jeong said, "Ten years have passed, but many still carry that pain. I pray for the repose of the deceased and offer my condolences to the bereaved family. I will create a Seoul where everyone has the right to work safely." <<> He then wrote, "I will create Seoul with the right to work safely," on a board at the site and attached it to the memorial panel. <<> On the same day, Jeong announced plans to form a Life Safety Committee under the Seoul Metropolitan Government. He said, "With the passage of the Life Safety Basic Act, implementation is imminent. We will form a Life Safety Committee in Seoul to supplement standards that protect citizen safety not only in industrial sites but also in daily life." (정 후보는 이날 서울 광진구에서 열린 ‘구의역 산재사망 참사 10주기 추모문화제 및 서울시장 후보 생명안전 약속식’에 참석한 뒤 “오 후보는 본인 잘못이나 실수, 이런 부분이 있으면 꼭 이걸 정쟁화해서 벗어나려고 하는 것 같다”며 “과거 종묘 개발 문제로 많은 우려가 제기되자, 그때도 총리 토론을 제안하는 등 정치 쟁점화해서 벗어나려고 한 경우가 있었는데 이번에도 마찬가지”라고 했다. 이어 “이처럼 중요한 생명안전 협약식에 불참한 이유가 궁금하다”고 날을 세웠다.)

item.title: Former Minister Park Young-sun Takes Office as Standing Chair of Korean Women's Parliament (박영선 전 장관, 한국여성의정 상임대표 취임)
item.description:
Former Minister Park Young-sun Takes Office as Standing Chair of Korean Women's Parliament (박영선 전 장관, 한국여성의정 상임대표 취임 )

Former Minister of SMEs and Startups Park Young-sun will take office as the new standing chair of the Korean Women's Parliament. (박영선 전 중소기업벤처기업부 장관이 한국여성의정 신임 상임대표로 취임한다.)

The Korean Women's Parliament announced on the 22nd that it has appointed former Minister Park as the sixth-term new standing chair, following the results of its 2026 regular general assembly held last month. Established 13 years ago, the Korean Women's Parliament is a corporation under the jurisdiction of the National Assembly Speaker, composed of former and current female lawmakers. (한국여성의정은 지난달 열린 2026년도 한국여성의정 정기총회 결과에 따라 박 전 장관을 6기 신임 상임대표로 선임한다고 22일 밝혔다. 설립 13년을 맞은 한국여성의정은 전·현직 여성 국회의원으로 구성된 국회의장 산하의 사단법인이다.)

The Korean Women's Parliament announced plans to pursue a 10-year vision of becoming a "hub for gender legislation," including publishing a gender issues newsletter, establishing a gender legislation network, and hosting international symposiums. (한국여성의정은 향후 10년 비전으로 ‘젠더 입법의 허브’를 내걸고 젠더 이슈 뉴스레터 발행, 젠더 입법 네트워크 구성, 국제 심포지엄 개최 등을 진행할 계획이라고 밝혔다.)

New Standing Chair Park stated, "We must now move toward not only quantitative expansion but also qualitative expansion of women's political participation," adding, "I will strive to ensure that the Women's Parliament serves as a think tank leading gender agendas and gender issues." She continued, "To strengthen legal support for women's social participation and the enhancement of their status, I will do my utmost to ensure that the Gender Equality Act, covering political, economic, and social fields, passes through the National Assembly." <<>/> Alongside new Standing Chair Park, former Justice Party leader Sim Sang-jeung, former National Medical Center Director Ahn Myung-ok, People Power Party lawmaker Kim Hee-jung, and Democratic Party of Korea lawmaker Jin Sun-mee were appointed as sixth-term co-chairs. <<>/> The term of the sixth-term leadership begins on the 23rd and lasts for three years. The inauguration ceremony for the sixth-term leadership is scheduled to take place on the 23rd of next month at the National Assembly's Sarangjae in Yeouido, Seoul, during the Eoul Gathering event celebrating female winners of the June 3 local elections. (박 신임 상임대표는 “이제는 여성 정치 참여의 양적 확대뿐 아니라 질적 확대의 시대로 나아가야 한다”며 “여성의정이 젠더 의제와 젠더 이슈를 선도하는 싱크탱크 역할을 할 수 있도록 힘쓰겠다”고 했다. 이어 “여성의 사회 참여와 지위 향상을 위한 법적 뒷받침을 강화하기 위해 정치·경제·사회 각 분야의 남녀동수법이 국회를 통과할 수 있도록 최선을 다하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Foreign Ministry: “We Take Seriously the Testimony of Beatings by Israeli Forces... Will Take Action” (외교부 “‘이스라엘軍이 구타’ 증언 엄중 인식... 조치 취하겠다”)
item.description:
Foreign Ministry: “We Take Seriously the Testimony of Beatings by Israeli Forces... Will Take Action” (외교부 “‘이스라엘軍이 구타’ 증언 엄중 인식... 조치 취하겠다”)

On the 22nd, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated, regarding the claims of Korean activists who boarded a ship bound for Gaza, were captured by Israeli forces, and allegedly assaulted, that “the government takes seriously the testimony of our citizens that there were acts of beatings by Israeli forces.” (외교부는 22일 가자지구행 선박에 탔다가 이스라엘군에 나포돼 폭행당했다는 한국인 활동가들의 주장과 관련해 “정부는 이스라엘군의 구타 행위가 있었다는 우리 국민의 증언을 엄중하게 인식하고 있다”고 밝혔다.)

The Ministry added, “We have conveyed our serious concerns to the Israeli side, and depending on the results of the fact-finding, we will take measures commensurate with the gravity of the situation.” (외교부는 “이스라엘 측에 우리의 엄중한 인식을 전달했으며, 사실 관계 확인 결과에 따라 사안의 심각성에 부합하는 조치를 취해 나갈 것”이라고 했다.)

Activist Kim Ah-hyun (activity name: Haecho), upon returning to Korea with Kim Dong-hyun on the same day, said, “I was hit in the face multiple times by Israeli forces, so my left ear is actually not hearing well.” (활동가 김아현(활동명 해초)씨는 이날 김동현씨와 함께 귀국하면서 “(이스라엘군에) 얼굴을 여러 차례 맞아 사실 왼쪽 귀가 잘 안 들리는 상태”라고 말했다.)

Earlier, the two individuals boarded ships heading to Gaza alongside international activists to protest Israel’s blockade of Gaza. The ships were subsequently seized by Israeli forces, leading to their arrest, and they were released on the 20th. (앞서 두 사람은 최근 국제 활동가들과 함께 이스라엘의 가자지구 봉쇄에 항의한다는 의미로 가자지구로 향하는 선박에 각각 탑승했다. 이후 배가 이스라엘군에 나포되면서 체포됐다가 지난 20일 석방됐다.)

item.title: Three Years of Civil Servants' Overseas Training Reports Verified… 11 Cases Found to Be AI-Generated (공무원 해외 연수 보고서 3년치 검증해보니… 11건이 AI가 지어낸 글)
item.description:
Three Years of Civil Servants' Overseas Training Reports Verified… 11 Cases Found to Be AI-Generated (공무원 해외 연수 보고서 3년치 검증해보니… 11건이 AI가 지어낸 글)

Some of the "Overseas Training Result Reports" submitted by civil servants after returning from overseas training were found to be improperly fabricated using generative artificial intelligence (AI). (공무원들이 해외 연수를 다녀와서 낸 ‘국외 훈련 결과 보고서’ 일부가 생성형 인공지능(AI)으로 부정하게 지어낸 보고서인 것으로 나타났다.)

The Ministry of Personnel Management announced on the 22nd that, after verifying 1,385 overseas training result reports submitted over the past three years, 11 cases were found to have improperly used generative AI. (인사혁신처는 최근 3년간 제출된 국외 훈련 결과 보고서 1385건을 검증한 결과, 11건에서 생성형 AI가 부적절하게 활용된 것으로 드러났다고 22일 밝혔다.)

The Ministry explained that among the suspicious reports, it determined these 11 cases to be AI-generated products through step-by-step verification and external expert review. (인사처는 의심스러운 보고서 가운데 단계별 검증과 외부 전문가 심의를 거쳐 이 11건을 AI 생성물로 판정했다고 설명했다.)

In these 11 cases, phenomena were discovered that occur when generative AI-generated text is pasted without review, such as "AI hallucinations" fabricating nonexistent stories, citations of non-existent literature, and abnormal use of emojis and special symbols. (이 11건에서는 없는 이야기를 지어낸 ‘AI 환각’, 존재하지 않는 문헌의 인용, 이모티콘과 특수 기호의 비정상적인 사용 등 생성형 AI가 지어낸 글을 검수하지 않고 그대로 붙여넣었을 때 나타나는 현상들이 발견됐다.)

The Ministry stated that it is recovering training expenses given to the civil servants who submitted these reports for their overseas training. (인사처는 해당 보고서를 낸 공무원들에게 해외 연수 때 줬던 훈련비를 환수하고 있다고 밝혔다.)

Additionally, the Ministry reported that it has created "Guidelines for the Use of Generative Artificial Intelligence" and distributed them to civil servants. (이와 함께 인사처는 ‘생성형 인공지능 활용 지침’을 만들어 공무원들에게 배포했다고 전했다.)

The guidelines consider that civil servants undergoing training using generative AI as an auxiliary tool is not inherently problematic. However, it emphasized that generative AI should be used with a critical perspective, and the final responsibility lies with the civil servant themselves. (지침은 연수를 받는 공무원들이 생성형 AI를 보조적 도구로 사용하는 것 자체는 문제가 없다고 봤다. 다만 비판적인 시각을 갖고 생성형 AI를 활용해야 하며, 최종 책임은 공무원 본인에게 있다고 강조했다.)

The guidelines presented seven basic principles, including "pursuit of truthfulness in research content," "transparent disclosure of usage," "maintaining fairness," "ethical use," "critical perspective," and "protection of personal information." (지침은 ‘연구 내용의 진실성 추구’와 ‘활용 사실의 투명한 공개’ ‘공정성 유지’ ‘윤리적 활용’ ‘비판적 시각’ ‘개인정보 보호’ 등 7가지 기본 원칙을 제시했다.)

The Ministry stated that it completed the guidelines by analyzing similar guidelines from various research institutions and universities and receiving advice from AI research ethics experts. (인사처는 여러 연구 기관과 대학의 비슷한 지침을 분석하고 AI 연구 윤리 전문가의 조언을 받아 지침을 완성했다고 밝혔다.)

Kim Seong-hoon, Deputy Minister of the Ministry of Personnel Management, said, "Through these guidelines, we hope civil servants will use AI correctly with a sense of responsibility in the education and training process," and added, "We will strengthen management so that civil servant education and training can produce results." (인사처 김성훈 차장은 “이번 지침을 통해 공무원들이 교육·훈련 과정에서 책임 의식을 갖고 AI를 올바르게 사용할 수 있게 되기 바란다”며 “공무원 교육·훈련이 성과를 창출할 수 있게 관리를 강화해 나가겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee Orders Inspection of Fire Agency Chief…Suspected of Personal Misconduct (李대통령, 소방청장 감찰지시…개인 비위로 추정)
item.description:
President Lee Orders Inspection of Fire Agency Chief…Suspected of Personal Misconduct (李대통령, 소방청장 감찰지시…개인 비위로 추정)

The presidential office announced on the 22nd that President Lee Jae-myung has ordered an inspection of Kim Seung-ryong, the commissioner of the National Fire Agency. (이재명 대통령이 김승룡 소방청장에 대한 감찰을 지시했다고 청와대가 22일 밝혔다.)

Senior Spokesperson Kang Yu-jeong made this announcement through a press notice on the same day, stating that President Lee had ordered an immediate fact-finding investigation. Although the specific reason for the inspection was not disclosed, it is known to be related to "personal misconduct." The presidential office has not released any further details. (강유정 수석대변인은 이날 언론 공지를 통해 이같이 밝히며 이 대통령이 즉각적인 진상 확인을 지시했다고 전했다. 구체적인 감찰 이유는 공개되지 않았지만, ‘개인 비위로 인한 사유’로 알려졌다. 청와대는 이 밖의 사항에 대해서는 공개하지 않고 있다.)

Commissioner Kim had been acting as the head of the National Fire Agency for six months since September last year, when former Commissioner Heo Seok-gon was removed from his position on suspicion of involvement in the December 3 martial law incident, before being formally appointed as the new commissioner in March. (김 청장은 허석곤 전 청장이 12·3 비상계엄 가담 의혹으로 직위 해제된 지난해 9월부터 6개월 동안 소방청장 직무를 대행해오다 지난 3월 신임 소방청장에 임명됐다．)

Just two days prior, on the 20th, Commissioner Kim had received high praise at a cabinet meeting chaired by President Lee for his performance in preventing wildfires. (김 청장은 불과 이틀 전인 지난 20일 이 대통령 주재 국무회의에서 산불 예방 성과와 관련해 높은 평가를 받기도 했다.)

item.title: SM-6 ‘Patriot of the Sea’ Adoption Confirmed... Range of 400 km to be Mounted on Aegis Ships (‘바다의 패트리엇’ SM-6 도입 확정... 사거리 400km로 이지스함에 탑재)
item.description:
SM-6 ‘Patriot of the Sea’ Adoption Confirmed... Range of 400 km to be Mounted on Aegis Ships (‘바다의 패트리엇’ SM-6 도입 확정... 사거리 400km로 이지스함에 탑재)

The government finalized a plan on the 22nd to invest 530 billion won to purchase US-made SM-6 ship-to-air guided missiles by 2034. The SM-6 is a missile capable of intercepting aircraft, ballistic missiles, and cruise missiles, and is scheduled to be mounted on the Jeongjo the Great-class Aegis destroyers. (정부가 5300억원을 투입해 2034년까지 미국산 SM-6 함대공 유도탄을 구입하는 계획을 22일 확정했다. SM-6는 항공기, 탄도미사일, 순항미사일을 요격할 수 있는 미사일로, 정조대왕급 이지스 구축함에 탑재될 예정이다.)

The Defense Acquisition Program Administration (DAPA) announced that it held a meeting of the Defense Acquisition Program Promotion Committee (DAPPC) on the same day and confirmed this procurement plan. The SM-6, known as the 'Patriot of the Sea', has a maximum range of 400 km and features an 'active guidance system' where the missile directly tracks the target using its own radar. Currently, the SM-2 ship-to-air guided missiles deployed by our navy have a maximum range of less than 200 km, and the government expects that the introduction of the SM-6 will enhance the engagement capabilities of Aegis ships and the ability to intercept North Korean missiles. (방위사업청은 이날 방위사업추진위원회(방추위)를 열고 이 같은 구매 계획을 확정했다고 발표했다. ‘바다의 패트리엇’이라고 불리는 SM-6는 최대 사정거리 400㎞로, 미사일이 자체 레이더로 목표를 직접 추적하는 ‘능동형 유도 체계’를 갖추고 있다. 현재 우리 해군에 배치된 SM-2 함대공 유도탄은 최대 사정거리 200㎞ 이하로, 정부는 SM-6 도입으로 이지스함 교전 능력과 북한 미사일 요격 능력을 강화할 수 있을 것으로 기대하고 있다.)

Earlier, in 2023, the DAPPC had approved the basic strategy revision and initial procurement plan for the SM-6-class long-range ship-to-air guided missile project. The approval on this day marked the final decision to introduce the SM-6 model. (앞서 방사청은 지난 2023년 방추위에서 SM-6급 장거리 함대공 유도탄 사업 추진 기본 전략 수정안 및 1차 구매 계획안을 의결했었다. 이날 의결은 SM-6 기종 도입을 최종 결정한 의미가 있다.)

Meanwhile, at the DAPPC on this day, the 'Military Satellite Communication System-III' research and development project's system development basic plan (draft) was also reviewed and approved. This project involves replacing aging military-dedicated geostationary communication satellites and developing ground terminals with improved transmission speeds. Approximately 1.27 trillion won is expected to be invested in this R&D from this year until 2032. (한편 이날 방추위에선 노후된 군 전용 정지궤도 통신 위성을 교체하고, 전송 속도가 향상된 지상부 단말기를 개발하는 ‘군위성통신체계-Ⅲ’ 연구개발 사업 체계개발기본계획(안)도 심의·의결됐다. 이 연구개발엔 올해부터 2032년까지 약 1조2700억원이 투입될 예정이다.)

item.title: ‘National Normalization’ Project Launched… 164 Tasks Including Relaxation of School Zone Restrictions, Expanded Disclosure of North Korean Materials (‘국가 정상화’ 프로젝트 가동… 스쿨존 제한 완화, 北 자료 공개 확대 등 164과제 추진)
item.description:
‘National Normalization’ Project Launched… 164 Tasks Including Relaxation of School Zone Restrictions, Expanded Disclosure of North Korean Materials (‘국가 정상화’ 프로젝트 가동… 스쿨존 제한 완화, 北 자료 공개 확대 등 164과제 추진)

The government on the 22nd disclosed 164 ‘national normalization’ tasks selected with the aim of “rectifying abnormal practices and systems throughout society.” Following President Lee Jae-myung’s directive at a cabinet meeting on April 10 to “form a team and identify normalization projects by each ministry to implement,” all central ministries have established ‘sectoral normalization task forces (TFs)’ to prepare these normalization tasks. <<> Shim Jong-seop, head of the Office for Government Policy Coordination, said regarding the ‘National Normalization General TF’ set up under the Office for Government Policy Coordination at the Government Complex Seoul that morning, “Each ministry’s TF identified over 500 tasks through public proposals and brainstorming sessions with field workers. Subsequently, the general TF selected and newly identified tasks, finalizing 164 primary tasks.” <<> The government categorized the tasks into five types: ‘structural corruption and misconduct,’ ‘evasive tactics to bypass the law,’ ‘actions for unjust gains,’ ‘laws and systems disconnected from reality,’ and ‘laws and systems out of sync with public sentiment.’ <<> In the ‘structural corruption and misconduct’ category, ▲violence in the sports sector was prioritized. Measures include preventing individuals with criminal records from entering the sports field, strictly punishing perpetrators of violence, and ensuring anonymity for whistleblowers. ▲The Korea Football Association’s presidential election will adopt a direct voting system, and the selection process for the national team coach and domestic match referees will be made transparent. ▲Non-profit corporations affiliated with the government will undergo comprehensive inspections to liquidate ghost corporations or privatized entities with no actual activities, while establishing a management and oversight system for transparent operations of existing corporations. ▲To eradicate improper perks for retirees at the Korea Expressway Corporation and ▲railway public institutions, a full investigation of retirees will be conducted, and retiree organizations will be excluded from profitable highway rest area businesses. <<> Additionally, ▲a system will be introduced to sanction companies engaged in collusive practices through registration cancellation, disqualification of executives, and suspension of bidding eligibility for public sector contracts. ▲Companies that refuse to cooperate with Fair Trade Commission investigations will face fines or enforcement levies equivalent to a certain percentage of their total sales. Amid growing concerns that forestry business corporations involved in wildfire damage restoration and forest management are hotbeds of corruption—through setting up ghost companies, illegal leasing of certifications, and shutting down after substandard work—▲measures will be pursued to strengthen incorporation requirements for forestry business corporations, raise bid deposits, introduce capacity evaluations, and enhance penalties for illegal acts. <<> In the ‘evasive tactics’ category, ▲to improve the effectiveness of government price stabilization actions in areas where hoarding occurs, companies that fail to comply with government measures will face disposal orders and enforcement levies, seized goods will be forcibly sold, and a system of fines and rewards for reporting hoarding will be newly established. ▲For private academies or instructors involved in illegal acts, measures such as suspension of teaching, teaching restrictions, and fines will be imposed. ▲For school uniforms, upper price limits will be set by item, and investigations into unfair practices like bid collusion will be conducted. <<> Meanwhile, ▲apartments and other multi-unit dwellings such as office-tels and row houses will be required to disclose management fee details, and local governments will be empowered to conduct administrative investigations into housing suspected of embezzlement. ▲The introduction of punitive damages and fines for illegal private servers for commercially sold games will be reviewed. ▲For products sold in fixed quantities, such as milk and snacks, the number of inspections to verify correct quantities will be increased tenfold, and results will be made public. <<> ▲Postpartum care centers, when closing or suspending operations, will be required to notify local governments and users within a certain prior period. ▲The National Health Insurance Service will be granted special judicial police powers to crack down on fraudulent medical treatments and fake patients in claims for nursing benefits. ▲The practice of public institutions splitting employment contracts into terms of less than one year to avoid paying severance to fixed-term workers will also be eliminated. <<> ▲To prevent corporations from holding high-value homes for non-business purposes, a full inspection of address registrations and actual users of corporate-owned homes will be conducted. ▲Cracking down on the practice of splitting overseas direct purchases into multiple shipments under the duty-free limit to evade customs duties will also occur. ▲To prevent ‘swarm bidding’ for public sector construction contracts, companies’ qualification for the work will be investigated, and firms that repeatedly abandon bids will be subject to bid deposits. <<> In the ‘actions for unjust gains’ category, ▲those selling scalped tickets for performances or sports events will face fines, while whistleblowers will receive rewards. ▲Private ambulances will be monitored in real-time via GPS to crack down on fake ambulance operations. ▲Illegal structures in dam areas, rivers, water source protection zones, and national parks will be fully investigated, with fines imposed and illegal profits recovered through system reforms. ▲Distribution of Onnuri gift certificates through illegal means will result in fines. ▲For the New Start Fund support, virtual asset holdings will also be reviewed to ensure that those with sufficient capacity to repay existing debts do not receive support. <<> In the ‘laws and systems disconnected from reality’ category, ▲the currently excessive number of tax exemption and reduction systems will be completely reviewed from scratch. ▲Plans will also be pursued to expand class action lawsuits and strengthen punitive damages for relief of victims in small-amount, mass-damage cases. ▲Laws will be established to crack down on drunk driving of agricultural machinery like tractors and tillers when operating on roads. ▲A standard pricing system will be introduced for usage fees of items like beach umbrellas at beaches. ▲The task also includes establishing a ‘Public Interest Reporting Promotion Fund’ to ensure sufficient budget for rewards given to whistleblowers of illegal acts. ▲Measures will be pursued to not apply vehicle speed limits in school zones during late-night hours when children’s traffic is low. <<> In the ‘laws and systems out of sync with public sentiment’ category, ▲disclosure of North Korean materials, previously managed as ‘subversive publications,’ ‘special materials,’ or ‘seditious expressions,’ will be expanded. ▲Government medals and decorations awarded to participants in insurrection, military rebellion, or perpetrators of state violence will be revoked. <<> Among these tasks, measures that can be taken at the government level—such as amending enforcement decrees and rules or changing internal guidelines—will be implemented immediately. For major tasks involving structural corruption, the Office for Government Policy Coordination will conduct direct on-site inspections and investigations to enhance momentum. <<> Director Shim stated, “We will ensure that outcomes are reported to the public at the time of the presidential work report scheduled after local elections,” adding, “Even for tasks not completed by then, we will explain the progress and direction.” <<> He also said, “The remaining tasks among the over 500 that were not included this time are also abnormal cases identified from citizens’ daily lives, so we plan to classify them as ministry-led tasks and improve them.” (정부가 “사회 곳곳의 비정상적 관행과 제도를 바로잡겠다”며 선정한 ‘국가 정상화’ 과제 164개를 22일 공개했다. 정부는 이재명 대통령이 지난 4월 10일 국무회의에서 “팀을 만들어 비정상의 정상화 사업을 부처별로 뽑아서 해보라”고 주문한 이후, 모든 중앙 부처에 ‘분야별 정상화 TF(태스크포스)’를 설치해 ‘정상화’ 과제를 준비해 왔다.)

item.title: Shin Dong-wook’s “Ha Jung-woo, fighting” sparks controversy... Han says, “Are they helping Ha to block me?” Park says, “Just an ordinary greeting.” (신동욱 “하정우 화이팅” 논란에... 韓 “나 막으려 河 돕나” 朴 “평범한 인사”)
item.description:
Shin Dong-wook’s “Ha Jung-woo, fighting” sparks controversy... Han says, “Are they helping Ha to block me?” Park says, “Just an ordinary greeting.” (신동욱 “하정우 화이팅” 논란에... 韓 “나 막으려 河 돕나” 朴 “평범한 인사”)

During a campaign rally for People Power Party (PPP) candidate Park Min-shik in the Bu san Buk-gu by-election on the 22nd, PPP Supreme Council member Shin Dong-wook accidentally encountered Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo and shouted “fighting,” sparking debate within the PPP. Independent candidate Han Dong-hoon, running in the same district, said, “How absurd is it that the PPP is helping Democratic Party’s Ha Jung-woo to block Han Dong-hoon?” In response, candidate Park Min-shik retorted, “Is turning an ordinary greeting into a unification scenario what Han Dong-hoon’s side calls politics?” <<> Supreme Council member Shin visited Manduk Market in Buk-gu with candidate Park that day, appealing for support from residents. Shin said, “I ask you to vote for candidate Park Min-shik, who was born in Buk-gu, raised by Buk-gu, and whose mother still lives here.” During the same time, Shin accidentally met candidate Ha Jung-woo, who was also campaigning at Manduk Market, inside a restaurant. However, a scene of Shin offering a handshake to Ha and saying, “Ha Jung-woo, fighting! I’m Shin Dong-wook,” spread online, sparking controversy. <<> Pro-Han Dong-hoon figures within the PPP immediately criticized Shin. PPP lawmaker Bae Hyun-jin wrote on Facebook, “‘Ha Jung-woo fighting’? I hope Shin (a lawmaker for Seocho-gu in Seoul) returns to Seoul.” She added, “People might misunderstand that the Jang Dong-hyuk leadership went to unite Ha Jung-woo and Park Min-shik.” Lawmaker Jeong Seong-guk posted on Facebook, “Supreme Council member Shin, who said ‘Ha Jung-woo fighting,’ is the one engaging in acts harmful to the party.” Former Supreme Council member Kim Jong-hyuk also wrote on Facebook, “It seems the Jang Dong-hyuk leadership is risking everything to bring down Han Dong-hoon.” <<> As the controversy escalated, Supreme Council member Shin issued a statement. Shin wrote on Facebook that day, “I visited Manduk Market in Buk-gu to support candidate Park,” and “While campaigning, I stopped at a restaurant for lunch and happened to run into Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo’s group, exchanging pleasantries.” He added, “We took a commemorative photo together with the restaurant owner and all shouted, ‘OO Restaurant, fighting!’” <<> However, candidate Han Dong-hoon continued to criticize Shin. Han posted on Facebook, “Supreme Council member Shin is even trying to spin ‘Ha Jung-woo fighting’ as ‘OO Restaurant fighting,’” and “Even he knows how absurd it is to help Democratic Party’s Ha Jung-woo to block Han Dong-hoon.” He then uploaded a video showing Shin saying “Ha Jung-woo fighting” on his Facebook. <<> In response, candidate Park Min-shik refuted that Han Dong-hoon and others were overinterpreting a simple greeting exchanged incidentally between candidates on the campaign trail. Park wrote on Facebook, “On the election scene, all candidates walk the same markets and alleys. It’s basic human decency to greet each other when you meet.” He added, “Is turning an ordinary greeting into a unification scenario what Han Dong-hoon’s side calls politics? Since their begging for unification failed, they’re lying.” <<> Park further stated, “For candidate Han Dong-hoon, the goal of this election isn’t victory,” adding, “His goal is to defeat Park Min-shik, undermine the PPP candidate, and ruin the PPP.” He continued, “Stop immediately distorting an incidental greeting on the campaign trail maliciously and spreading the false claim of unification,” and “I will consider all measures, including legal action, against such excessive distortion and spreading of falsehoods.” He concluded, “There is no unification. I will go all the way and win.” <<> Supreme Council member Shin posted again on Facebook, stating, “While campaigning with our party’s candidate Park Min-shik, I happened to run into Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo and, thinking ‘You must be struggling in your first election,’ I offered a ‘fighting’ greeting.” He added, “Even though I haven’t met him in person, I would have offered the same greeting to candidate Han Dong-hoon if I had.” He concluded, “Seeing them swarm like bees at the thought of creating an issue seems rather pitiful, but I wish them fighting spirit for the rest of the campaign period.” (22일 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마한 국민의힘 박민식 후보 지원 유세 도중 국민의힘 신동욱 최고위원이 우연히 더불어민주당 하정우 후보를 만나 “화이팅”을 외친 것을 놓고 국민의힘 안팎에서 언쟁이 오갔다. 이 지역에 무소속 출마한 한동훈 후보는 “(국민의힘이) 한동훈 막으려고 민주당 하정우 돕는 것이 얼마나 황당한가”라고 했고, 이에 박민식 후보는 “평범한 인사 한 장면을 단일화로 둔갑시키는 게 한동훈 측이 말하는 정치인가”라고 받아쳤다.)

item.title: Jang: "Criticism of Starbucks is for Consumers... Is It a Matter for the President and Ministers to Step In?" (張 “스타벅스 비난은 소비자 몫... 대통령·장관까지 나설 일인가”)
item.description:
Jang: "Criticism of Starbucks is for Consumers... Is It a Matter for the President and Ministers to Step In?" (張 “스타벅스 비난은 소비자 몫... 대통령·장관까지 나설 일인가”)

Jang Dong-hyuk, floor leader of the People Power Party, said on the 22nd, targeting the government and ruling party's strong response to the controversy over Starbucks' "Tank Day" marketing, "This local election is an election to break away from Lee Jae-myung's reign of terror." (국민의힘 장동혁 대표가 스타벅스의 ‘탱크 데이’ 마케팅 논란과 관련한 정부·여권의 강경한 대응을 겨냥해 “이번 지방선거는 이재명의 공포정치를 끊어내는 선거”라고 22일 말했다.)

In a post on his Facebook that day, Floor Leader Jang stated, "One can criticize the act of using a painful history for corporate marketing. However, that is the consumer's prerogative. It is not a matter for the President and ministers to step in, launch a boycott, and intimidate the people." (장 대표는 이날 자신의 페이스북에 글을 올려 “아픈 역사를 기업의 마케팅에 활용한 행위를 비난할 수 있다. 그러나 그것은 소비자의 몫”이라며 “대통령과 장관들까지 나서서 불매운동을 벌이고 국민을 겁박할 일은 아니다”라고 밝혔다.)

He continued, "The spirit of May 18 must not become a tool of political violence that intimidates the people," adding, "A country where you have to watch your step for fear of being punished just for drinking a cup of coffee—how did South Korea end up like this?" (이어 “5·18 정신이 국민을 겁박하는 정치적 폭력의 수단이 되어서는 안 된다”며 “커피 한 잔 마시는 것도 처벌받을까봐 눈치를 봐야 하는 나라, 대한민국이 어쩌다 여기까지 오게 되었나”라고 했다.)

Furthermore, he said, "What political gain is the Lee Jae-myung administration, which claims to be a 'government of popular sovereignty,' trying to achieve by dividing the people like this?" and added, "Lee Jae-myung's dictatorship and reign of terror are not a future model after the local elections, but an ongoing reality." (또 “‘국민주권정부’를 표방하던 이재명 정권이 이렇게 국민을 갈라쳐서 얻으려는 정치적 이득이 도대체 무엇일까”라며 “이재명의 독재정치, 공포정치는 지방선거 이후 다가올 미래형이 아니라 현재진행형”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Pro-Roh, Pro-Moon Factions Siding with Cho Kuk... Cracks Emerge in Ruling Bloc Over Pyeongtaek-eul By-Election (조국 편드는 친노·친문... 평택을 재선 여권 균열)
item.description:
Pro-Roh, Pro-Moon Factions Siding with Cho Kuk... Cracks Emerge in Ruling Bloc Over Pyeongtaek-eul By-Election (조국 편드는 친노·친문... 평택을 재선 여권 균열)

Cracks are emerging in the ruling bloc over the parliamentary by-election in Pyeongtaek-eul, Gyeonggi Province. Five candidates are running: Kim Yong-nam of the Democratic Party of Korea, Yoo Eui-dong of the People Power Party, Cho Kuk of the Rebuilding Korea Party, Kim Jae-yeon of the Progressive Party, and Hwang Kyo-ahn of the Liberty and Innovation Party. According to various polls, Kim Yong-nam and Cho Kuk are competing for the lead, with verbal clashes intensifying between the two. <<> Kim Yong-nam and Cho Kuk engaged in a war of nerves during a candidate debate hosted by the Pyeongtaek Regional Media Council on the 22nd. When asked whether the progressive camp would pursue candidate unification if a win seemed challenging, Cho responded, "If a situation arises where a party of insurrectionists returns to the National Assembly, the public will order unification. I will follow that order." In contrast, Kim Yong-nam stated, "Having different parties means different goals," and declared he would complete the race. When Cho asked, "Have you seen my pledge to attract the Asia-Pacific AI Center to Pyeongtaek?" Kim replied, "There are some overlapping aspects with my pledges," but added, "Honestly, I don't have much interest in Cho's pledges." The two did not directly attack each other, and most of their individual debate time was spent questioning the conservative candidate. <<> However, just hours before the debate, harsh exchanges took place between the two sides. During a street rally on the 21st, Kim Yong-nam targeted Cho Kuk, saying, "How envious must one be of the color blue (the Democratic Party's symbolic color) to turn their face blue?" This was a dig at Cho, who recently bruised his right eye after bumping into a glass door, after Cho criticized him for being "un-Democratic Party-like." Kim had previously served as a lawmaker for the Saenuri Party (the predecessor of the People Power Party) before moving through the Reform Party and joining the Democratic Party ahead of the last presidential election. <<> Cho Kuk's campaign released a statement on the 22nd, saying, "We see Kim's true character in his mocking of a bruised eye from an injury," adding, "That's why he could make outlandish remarks toward the families of the Sewol ferry and Itaewon disaster victims." The statement also questioned, "Since when was Kim blue?" <<> Amid the controversy, Democratic Party Secretary General Cho Seung-rae pointed out during a press briefing regarding Kim's remarks, "Every word must be carefully considered" and noted, "Using negative language is not very helpful for gaining votes." <<> Opinions among ruling bloc figures are divided over the Pyeongtaek-eul by-election. Former President of the Roh Moo-hyun Foundation Yoo Si-min said on Kim Eo-jun's YouTube channel on the 21st, "For the Democratic Party to pursue integration and solidarity while driving social reform, it's better for Cho Kuk to be elected," adding, "If Kim wins, it might be good for the Democratic Party right now, but I worry about whether it would be good for South Korea." Earlier, former Roh Moo-hyun presidential chief of civil affairs Lee Ho-cheol declared, "Though I'm a Democratic Party member, I support Cho Kuk." Pro-Roh and Pro-Moon figures have sided with Cho. <<> In contrast, Democratic Party lawmaker Park Jie-won posted on Facebook late on the 21st, "If Cho Kuk wins, it could make things difficult for the Democratic Party," adding, "Cho should withdraw his candidacy to find a future for himself and the Rebuilding Korea Party." In response, the Rebuilding Korea Party mentioned that Kim had previously criticized former President Kim Dae-jung's "Sunshine Policy," stating, "The candidate who should withdraw is Kim Yong-nam." <<> Recent polls show Kim Yong-nam, Yoo Eui-dong, and Cho Kuk leading the pack, with Kim Jae-yeon and Hwang Kyo-ahn trailing behind. There is talk of a potential unification between Yoo Eui-dong and Hwang Kyo-ahn. The Democratic Party leadership is still leaving the door open for unification between Kim Yong-nam and Cho Kuk. Secretary General Cho Seung-rae said, "We are closely monitoring the election trends," and added, "A decisive unification could happen, or it might not." With early voting scheduled for the 29th and 30th, a decision on unification needs to be made soon. (경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거를 놓고 여권이 균열 조짐을 보이고 있다. 이곳엔 더불어민주당 김용남, 국민의힘 유의동, 조국혁신당 조국, 진보당 김재연, 자유와혁신 황교안 후보 등 5명이 출마했다. 각종 여론조사에서 김용남, 조국 후보가 선두를 놓고 경쟁하는 가운데, 두 후보 간 설전이 격화되고 있다.)

item.title: President Lee Orders Inspection of Fire Service Commissioner (李대통령 “소방청장 감찰하라”)
item.description:
The presidential office announced on the 22nd that President Lee Jae-myung has ordered an inspection of Fire Service Commissioner Kim Seung-ryong. Commissioner Kim was appointed to the position by President Lee in March of this year after former Commissioner Heo Seok-gon was dismissed amid suspicions of involvement in the December 3 martial law declaration. (이재명 대통령이 김승룡 소방청장에 대한 감찰을 지시했다고 청와대가 22일 밝혔다. 김 청장은 12·3 비상계엄 가담 의혹으로 허석곤 전 청장이 직위 해제되면서 이 대통령이 올 3월 소방청장에 임명했다.)

Senior Spokesperson Kang Yoo-jung made this announcement through a press release, stating that President Lee ordered an immediate fact-finding investigation. While the specific reason for the inspection was not disclosed, it is known to be "due to personal misconduct." The presidential office stated, "As the inspection has commenced, further specific details are difficult to provide," and declined to disclose additional information. Commissioner Kim also said in a phone call with the press that he "has no knowledge" of the reason for the inspection. There have been reports of confusion within the National Fire Agency as well. However, a source from the ruling party said, "I understand that suspicions regarding business expense misuse, abusive behavior, and inappropriate use of official vehicles have been raised in the past." <<> Just two days before the announcement of the inspection, on the 20th, Commissioner Kim received high praise from President Lee during a cabinet meeting for his achievements in wildfire prevention. At the meeting, President Lee told Commissioner Kim, "You have done a great job preventing major wildfires this winter." When Commissioner Kim reported key achievements such as improving the golden time arrival rate at disaster sites, advancing cutting-edge scientific firefighting with AI technology, and significantly reducing fire damage through prevention, President Lee reportedly asked, "Why didn't you mention that you have achieved such an incredible result in reducing large wildfires?" <<> On the 21st, Commissioner Kim delivered a keynote speech at the 2026 International Fire and Safety Expo in Daegu, announcing innovation strategies to realize a major transformation in firefighting. A native of Iksan, North Jeolla Province, Kim graduated from Hankuk University of Foreign Studies with a degree in German, entered the fire service through a competitive recruitment process for fire officers, and served as head of the Gangwon Special Self-Governing Province Fire Service Headquarters, director of the National Fire Agency's Equipment and Technology Bureau, and principal of the Central Fire Service Academy. Commissioner Kim served as acting fire service commissioner for six months starting from September last year, following the dismissal of former Commissioner Heo over suspicions of involvement in the December 3 martial law declaration. He was then appointed as the new fire service commissioner in March. At the time, the presidential office assessed that "Commissioner Kim had stably led the National Fire Agency during his six-month tenure as acting commissioner." (강유정 수석대변인은 이날 언론 공지를 통해 이같이 밝히며 이 대통령이 즉각적인 진상 확인을 지시했다고 전했다. 구체적인 감찰 이유는 공개되지 않았지만, ‘개인 비위로 인한 사유’로 알려졌다. 청와대는 “감찰에 착수한 사항이라 더 이상의 구체적인 설명은 곤란하다”며 이 밖의 사항에 대해서는 공개하지 않았다. 김 청장도 언론과의 통화에서 감찰 사유에 대해 “아는 바가 없다”고 했다. 소방청 내부에서도 당혹스럽다는 반응이 나오고 있다. 다만 한 여권 관계자는 “예전부터 업무추진비 의혹과 갑질 의혹, 관용차 부적절 이용 의혹 등이 거론돼 왔던 걸로 안다”고 했다.)

item.title: "South Korean Companies, Now Is the Time to Come: The 890 Trillion Won Ukraine Reconstruction Project" (“890조원 우크라 재건 사업 한국기업들 지금 바로 오라”)
item.description:
Senior Ukrainian officials, participating in a series of sessions on Ukraine’s reconstruction at the Asian Leadership Conference (ALC) held on the 20th and 21st, proposed that South Korean companies actively invest in Ukraine’s reconstruction market, which amounts to $588 billion (approximately 890 trillion won). With companies from the United States and Europe already entering Ukraine and actively collaborating with local businesses, they urged South Korean firms not to miss this business opportunity. (우크라이나 고위 관계자들은 20~21일 열린 아시안리더십콘퍼런스(ALC)의 우크라이나 재건 관련 연쇄 세션에 참가해 “한국 기업들이 5880억달러(약 890조원)에 달하는 우크라 재건 시장에 적극 투자해 달라”고 제안했다. 미국·유럽 등 기업들이 이미 우크라이나에 진출해 현지 기업들과 활발하게 협력하고 있는 상황에서, 한국 기업들이 ‘사업 기회’를 놓치지 말라는 것이다.)

Vitaliy Kim, Governor of Ukraine’s Mykolaiv region, stated during the session titled "Europe After Ukraine: A New Order of Security, Reconstruction, and Growth" on the 20th that "the Ukraine reconstruction project is the largest investment project since the post-World War II recovery efforts," adding, "Many companies are participating in the reconstruction, and South Korean companies also need to explore markets of interest." He cited an example from 2023, when Danish wind turbine manufacturer Vestas partnered with Ukrainian energy company DTEK to install a 114 MW wind power facility, with additional contracts expanding the scale to approximately 500 MW. (비탈리 김 우크라이나 미콜라이우주(州) 주지사는 20일 ‘우크라이나 이후의 유럽: 안보, 재건, 성장의 새로운 질서’ 세션에서 “우크라이나 재건 프로젝트는 2차 세계대전 (복구 사업) 이래 가장 큰 투자 프로젝트”라며 “많은 기업들이 재건에 참여하고 있고, 한국 기업들도 관심 있는 시장을 탐색할 필요가 있다”고 말했다. 그러면서 2023년 덴마크의 풍력 터빈 제조사 베스타스가 우크라이나 에너지 회사 DTEK와 협력해 114㎿(메가와트) 규모의 풍력 발전 시설을 설치했고, 추가 계약을 통해 그 규모를 약 500㎿로 늘리고 있는 사례 등을 언급했다.)

Tetiana Prokopchuk, Vice President of the American Chamber of Commerce in Ukraine, noted, "In Ukraine’s reconstruction market, expected to reach $588 billion (about 890 trillion won) over the next decade, five sectors—housing, energy, transportation, commerce, and agriculture—account for approximately $400 billion (about 610 trillion won)." She emphasized, "Capital follows opportunity, and opportunity follows scale," suggesting this is a prime chance for large-scale investment. Last year, the United States and Ukraine agreed to establish the "U.S.-Ukraine Reconstruction Investment Fund (URIF)" to foster energy and logistics enterprises, jointly contributing an initial capital of $150 million. (테타냐 프로콥추크 우크라이나 주재 미국상공회의소 부회장은 “우크라이나에서 향후 10년간 예상되는 5880억달러(약 890조원) 재건 시장에서 주택·에너지·운송·상업·농업 등 5개 부문이 약 4000억달러(약 610조원)를 차지한다”며 “자본은 기회를 따라가고, 기회는 규모를 따라간다”고 말했다. 대규모 투자를 할 수 있는 좋은 기회라는 것이다. 작년 미국과 우크라이나는 에너지·물류 기업 육성을 위한 ‘미국·우크라이나 재건 투자 기금(URIF)’을 만들기로 합의하고, 초기 자본금으로 1억5000만달러를 공동 출자했다.)

Prokopchuk also stated, "According to a survey of around 600 local chamber member companies, 61% of members plan to expand their businesses in Ukraine this year." While the war has significantly impacted local businesses, this indicates an optimistic outlook for future recovery. She added, "Investing in Ukraine is not charity; it is clearly a business." According to foreign media, U.S. companies in diverse sectors such as Westinghouse (nuclear power), Cargill (agriculture), and Microsoft (IT) have been consistently investing in Ukraine in recent years. (프로콥추크 부회장은 “현지 (미 상공회의소) 회원사 600여곳을 상대로 한 설문조사에 따르면, 회원사 61%가 올해 우크라이나에서 사업을 확대할 계획”이라고도 했다. 전쟁으로 현지 기업들이 상당한 타격을 받은 것은 사실이지만, 그만큼 향후 회복세를 낙관적으로 전망한다는 것이다. 그는 “우크라이나 투자는 자선(charity)이 아닌, 분명한 사업(business)”이라고도 했다. 외신 등에 따르면, 최근 수년간 웨스팅하우스(원전), 카길(농업), 마이크로소프트(IT) 등 다양한 분야의 미국 기업들도 우크라이나에 꾸준히 투자해 왔다.)

It was also noted that despite Ukraine being at war, its basic public systems are functioning normally. Roksolana Pidlasa, Chair of the Budget Committee of the Ukrainian Parliament, stated, "The government is performing its functions and is financially sound, with all public services being provided promptly." She explained that the push for digitalization of public services during the COVID-19 crisis in 2020, along with the relocation of key government offices to western Ukraine after the outbreak of war, has helped maintain the public systems. (우크라이나가 전쟁 중이지만, 기본적인 공공 시스템은 정상 가동되고 있다는 점도 언급됐다. 록솔라나 피들라사 우크라이나 의회 예산위원장은 “정부는 제 기능을 수행하고 있고 재정적으로도 건전하다”며 “모든 정부 서비스가 신속하게 제공되고 있다”고 했다. 2020년 코로나 위기 때 공공 서비스 디지털화를 본격적으로 추진했고, 전쟁 발발 이후 주요 관공서를 우크라이나 서부로 이동시킨 덕분에 공공 시스템이 유지될 수 있었다는 설명이다.)

Some participants suggested that South Korea, which achieved rapid growth from the ruins of the Korean War, serves as a "model case" for Ukraine. Svitlana Kovalchuk, Secretary General of the Yalta European Strategy (YES) in Ukraine, said during the session "Ukraine’s Reconstruction and Industrial Transformation: Strategic Cooperation between South Korea and Ukraine," "South Korea grew from a completely devastated country into one of the most influential economic leaders within a single generation," calling it "a very significant example." She highlighted that South Korea’s establishment of various export industrial complexes in the 1960s serves as a valuable reference for Ukraine’s reconstruction process. (6·25전쟁의 폐허로부터 고도 성장한 한국이 우크라이나에 ‘모범 케이스’가 된다는 의견도 있었다. 스비틀라나 코발추크 우크라이나 얄타유럽전략(YES) 사무총장은 ‘우크라이나 재건과 산업 전환: 한국·우크라이나 전략적 협력’ 세션에서 “한국은 완전히 황폐화된 국가에서 한 세대 만에 가장 영향력 있는 경제 선도국 가운데 하나로 성장했다”며 “매우 큰 본보기”라고 했다. 특히 1960년대 한국이 각종 수출 산업단지를 조성한 것이 우크라이나 재건 과정에서 좋은 참고가 된다고 했다.)

There was also an opinion that investing in Ukraine’s defense sector could improve South Korea’s military technology. Governor Vitaliy Kim remarked, "We are gaining many new experiences on the battlefield right now," and added, "Collaborating with technologically advanced South Korean defense companies could be mutually beneficial." (방산 분야에서 우크라이나에 투자하는 것이 한국의 군사 기술을 개선시킬 수 있다는 의견도 나왔다. 비탈리 김 주지사는 “우리는 지금 전장에서 많은 새로운 경험을 하고 있다”며 “기술적으로 뛰어난 한국 방산 기업과 협력하면 서로에게 이익이 될 수 있을 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: "Semiconductors, Supply Chains, and AI Are the Driving Force… Now Is the Era of Economic Alliances" (“반도체·공급망·AI가 힘… 이젠 경제동맹 시대”)
item.description:
Diplomatic and security experts from U.S. think tanks stated, "The U.S. will continue to maintain overwhelming military power as the world's top power, but it won't cover everything," adding, "South Korea's role must expand well beyond being centered on North Korea." (미국 싱크탱크 소속 외교·안보 전문가들은 “미국은 앞으로도 세계 제1 강국으로서 압도적 군사력을 유지하겠지만 모든 곳을 다 챙기진 않을 것”이라며 “한국의 역할도 대북 중심에서 벗어나 더 크게 확장해야 한다”고 했다.)

Experts from four major U.S. think tanks—the Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS), RAND Corporation, Brookings Institution, and Hudson Institute—delivered this assessment during four consecutive sessions at the Asian Leadership Conference (ALC) on the 20th and 21st, regarding the rapidly changing international situation following the inauguration of the second Trump administration and the Korea-U.S. alliance. Mick Mulvaney, former White House Chief of Staff under President Trump and an ALC speaker, also predicted, "'America First' is not merely President Trump's personal political slogan. Even after Trump, the non-interventionist foreign policy stance implied by this slogan will continue on a bipartisan basis, with only subtle changes in expression." (전략국제문제연구소(CSIS)·랜드(RAND)·브루킹스·허드슨 등 미 4대 싱크탱크 전문가들은 20~21일 아시안리더십콘퍼런스(ALC)의 4차례 연쇄 세션에서 트럼프 2기 행정부 출범 이후 급변하는 국제 정세와 한·미 동맹 등과 관련, 이 같은 진단을 내놓았다. ALC 연사로 참여한 믹 멀베이니 전 트럼프 대통령 비서실장도 “‘아메리칸 퍼스트(미국 우선주의)’는 트럼프 대통령의 개인적인 정치 구호에 그치는 것이 아니다”라며 “트럼프 이후에도 이 구호가 내포한 미국의 비(非)개입주의적 대외 정책 기조는 표현 방식만 미묘하게 달라질 뿐 초당적으로 이어질 것”이라고 전망했다.)

The experts noted that U.S. hegemony, maintained for about 30 years since the Cold War, is shifting to a 'strategy of preserving hegemony.' Andrew Yeo, the SK-Korea Foundation Chair at Brookings, said, "The U.S. values alliances and the liberal international order, but won't see them as ends in themselves. It will weigh costs and efficiency more, seeking to combine forces with allies as economic security and supply chain partners." Joseph Yun, former acting U.S. Ambassador to South Korea, added, "The Korea-U.S. alliance is evolving and must do so. It can no longer remain solely focused on North Korea." Mark Cozad, a senior security policy researcher at RAND, stated, "The Korea-U.S. alliance is becoming part of a global security network." <<> The shift in the concept of traditional alliances and security from the military domain to economics and science and technology was also emphasized. Patrick Cronin, Chair of Asia-Pacific Security at Hudson, said, "Semiconductors, rare earths, supply chains, and AI infrastructure are no longer just economic issues. They are becoming means of national power." He added, "The 'interdependence' formed by the securitization of economy and technology changes the concept of alliances, not only fostering bond and stability among allies but also serving as a leverage of power to deter rival forces." This suggests that if Korea and the U.S. build cooperative networks in cutting-edge technology fields like semiconductors and AI, they can also reap security benefits. <<> Heino Klinck, a RAND International Defense researcher and former U.S. Deputy Assistant Secretary of Defense for East Asia, said, "Alliances are being redefined around substantive national interests and economic security rather than values or ideology. What matters is whether an alliance generates economic, technological, and political outcomes." <<> Arguments were also made for revising the Korea-U.S. policy toward North Korea. Victor Cha, CSIS Korea Chair, stated, "North Korea has advanced its nuclear capabilities and strengthened military cooperation with Russia. North Korea is no longer the same as before." He added, "From the first North Korean nuclear crisis in 1994, Korea and the U.S. have repeated the same approach of achieving complete denuclearization for over 30 years, but without substantive results." He continued, "Rather than focusing solely on denuclearization, there is a need to concentrate on crisis management through tension reduction." However, former National Security Office Director Kim Sung-han warned, "Narratives are very important in international relations. If a narrative emerges that rogue nuclear development can be survived and the U.S. will eventually accept it, that is very dangerous. Approaching North Korean nukes from a disarmament perspective could invert the goal of complete denuclearization with the means of disarmament." Sydney Seiler, former U.S. National Intelligence Officer for North Korea and now CSIS Senior Advisor, also noted, "North Korea wants the ability to threaten Korea and the U.S. It won't accept any attempt to reduce or eliminate that, whether through disarmament or otherwise, so disarmament won't be easy, and we'll be plagued by North Korean threats and blackmail." <<> Mark Lippert, CSIS Senior Advisor, said, "The North Korea issue has been pushed back and forgotten in Washington. Currently, China, the Middle East, Ukraine, and domestic politics take greater priority." He added, "As long as North Korea doesn't cross three red lines—an ICBM launch, a 7th nuclear test, or a lethal strike against the South—the U.S. won't prioritize the North Korea issue. There's a need to focus on AI, quantum computing, and drones, which will revolutionize defense technology." <<> Experts analyzed that the U.S.-Israel war with Iran, the U.S.-China hegemonic struggle, and the Korean Peninsula issues are complexly interconnected. Chair Cronin said, "Iran sees China as its political shield and economic lifeline. China is playing the role of a patron protecting Iran from U.S. pressure." Researcher Cozad noted, "Relations between China, Russia, North Korea, and Iran are increasingly strengthening. They are exchanging not just military but also technological, economic, and political support to develop their ties." He added, "Currently, the Taiwan Strait is the most likely area for direct conflict between the U.S. and China. As China solidifies unity with multiple countries, strengthening the Korea-U.S. alliance and trilateral security cooperation with Japan are very important." (전문가들은 냉전 이후 약 30년간 유지된 미국 패권주의가 ‘패권 유지 전략’으로 전환되고 있다고 했다. 앤드루 여 브루킹스 SK·코리아재단 석좌는 “미국은 동맹의 가치와 자유주의적 국제 질서를 중시하지만 그 자체를 목적으로 하진 않을 것”이라면서 “비용과 효율을 보다 따지면서 경제 안보·공급망 파트너로서 동맹과 힘을 합치려 할 것”이라고 했다. 조셉 윤 전 주한 미 대사대리도 “한미 동맹은 진화 중이고 그래야만 한다”면서 “한미 동맹은 더 이상 대북용에 머물러선 안 된다”고 했다. 마크 코자드 랜드 선임 안보정책 연구원은 “한미 동맹은 글로벌 안보 네트워크의 일부가 되고 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: PPP’s Busan Candidates Growing Anxious… Jang Dong-hyuk Draws Line on Unification in Buk-gu Gap (국힘 부산 출마자들은 속 타는데… 장동혁, 북갑 단일화에 선 그어)
item.description:
People Power Party (PPP) leader Jang Dong-hyuk on the 22nd referred to independent candidate Han Dong-hoon, who is running in the Buk-gu Gap by-election for the National Assembly, as “someone who ruined conservatism.” The Buk-gu Gap National Assembly election is set to be a three-way race between Democratic Party of Korea candidate Ha Jung-woo, PPP candidate Park Min-shik, and independent Han Dong-hoon. Amid growing calls from some opposition circles for Park Min-shik and Han Dong-hoon to unify, Rep. Jang reaffirmed the party’s position against unification. <<> On the YouTube channel of the Maeil Shinmun that day, Jang said of Han, “Can a person who ruined conservatism convince the public that he will rebuild it?” He also commented on Park Min-shik’s shaved head at his campaign kickoff the previous day, saying, “Busan Buk-gu had been bogged down by the unification issue, but from yesterday onward, it’s been getting back on track.” On SBS Radio, Park explained his shaved head as “a message that unification with Han, a traitor to conservatism, is not possible.” <<> Han Dong-hoon also wrote on Facebook that day, “Jang Dong-hyuk’s faction and candidate Park Min-shik are only attacking me, effectively campaigning for the Democratic Party candidate.” He further posted a video showing Shin Dong-wook, a PPP Supreme Council member who had been campaigning with Park Min-shik, greeting Ha Jung-woo at a restaurant in Busan, and remarked, “It wasn’t just ‘Go Ha Jung-woo,’ but also ‘Let’s do well, our candidate Ha Jung-woo.’ Jang Dong-hyuk’s faction should just declare support for Democratic candidate Ha Jung-woo.” In response, Supreme Council member Shin said, “I offered words of encouragement, thinking it must be tough for him in his first election. I would have said the same to Han Dong-hoon if I had met him.” <<> As tensions escalate between the two candidates, concerns are growing among PPP candidates in the Busan region, including Busan mayoral candidate Park Hyung-joon. Rep. Park Soo-young, a former member of the pro-Yoon faction, recently wrote in a PPP lawmakers’ group chat, “My district, Busan Nam-gu, is typically a place where we win by 10 to 15 percentage points, but now we’re in a tight race of disadvantage. Without special measures from the Busan city party and the central party to turn the tide, the election will be difficult.” (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 22일 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마한 무소속 한동훈 후보에 대해 “보수를 망가뜨린 사람”이라고 했다. 부산 북갑 국회의원 선거는 더불어민주당 하정우 후보, 국민의힘 박민식 후보, 무소속 한동훈 후보의 3파전으로 치러진다. 야권 일각에서 박민식, 한동훈 후보가 단일화해야 한다는 의견이 나오는 가운데 장 대표가 단일화 불가 입장을 재확인한 것이다.)
