item.title: To End ‘Switch-Up’ Controversy… Advance Voting Ballot Box Stands to Become Transparent (바꿔치기 논란 더는 안 나오게… 사전투표함 받침대 투명해진다)
item.description:
Starting with this June 3 local election, the external stands for advance voting ballot boxes will be made of transparent material. This is aimed at blocking suspicions of election fraud, such as ballot box swapping. Advance voting for the June 3 local elections will take place over two days, from 6 a.m. to 6 p.m. on the 29th and 30th. (이번 6·3 지방선거부터 사전투표함 외부 받침대가 투명한 재질로 바뀐다. ‘투표함 바꿔치기’ 등 부정선거 의혹을 차단하겠다는 취지다. 6·3 지방선거 사전투표는 오는 29·30일 이틀간 오전 6시부터 오후 6시까지 진행된다.)

The National Election Commission (NEC) uses bag-type ‘sack-style ballot boxes’ for advance voting within the same district, as they are easy to store and transport. At polling stations, a plastic stand covers the sack to prevent it from tipping over, and later only the sack ballot box is removed to count the votes. (중앙선거관리위원회는 관내 사전투표 때 자루 형태의 ‘행낭식 투표함’을 쓰고 있다. 보관과 이동이 쉽기 때문이다. 투표소에선 자루가 쓰러지지 않도록 행낭을 감싸는 플라스틱 받침대를 씌우고, 나중에 행낭 투표함만 꺼내 표를 센다.)

An NEC official said on the 22nd, “The existing stands were opaque, so the sack-style ballot boxes were not visible. This led some voters to misunderstand that the ballot box differed when voting and when counting, so we decided to improve it.” Since only the stand becomes transparent and the sack-style ballot box remains unchanged, the ballots will not be visible from the outside. (선관위 관계자는 22일 “기존 받침대는 불투명해 행낭식 투표함이 보이지 않다 보니 일부 유권자가 투표할 때와 개표할 때 투표함이 달라졌다는 오해가 있어 개선하기로 했다”고 했다. 받침대만 투명하게 바뀌고 행낭식 투표함은 그대로 있기 때문에 투표용지가 외부에서 보이지는 않는다.)

The NEC also decided to improve the design of the advance voting ballot box stand. On the existing stand, the part where the seal is attached was close to the handle and had a step, which has now been made flat. Election officials occasionally damaged the seal while moving the ballot box, and some raised suspicions of intentional damage. Real-time footage from security cameras at advance voting ballot box storage locations will also be displayed on large monitors installed at provincial and city election commissions. (선관위는 사전투표함 받침대 디자인도 개선하기로 했다. 기존 받침대의 경우 봉인지를 붙이는 부분이 손잡이와 가깝고 단차도 있었는데 이를 평평하게 바꿨다. 선거 사무원들이 투표함을 옮기다 봉인지가 훼손되는 경우가 간혹 있었는데, 일각에서 고의 훼손 의혹을 제기하기도 했다. 사전투표함 보관장소의 방범 카메라 실시간 영상도 시·도 선관위에 설치된 대형 모니터를 통해 공개한다.)

The NEC changed the material and design of the advance voting stands to dispel various suspicions as the proportion of voters participating in advance voting rises. Advance voting was piloted in 2013. The advance voting rate in the 2014 local elections was 11.49%, rising to 20.14% in 2018 and 20.62% in the 2022 local elections. Since last year’s presidential election, the NEC has been disclosing the number of advance voters per polling station on an hourly basis, due to some claims that the advance voter count was inflated. (선관위가 사전투표 받침대 재질과 디자인을 바꾼 것은 유권자 가운데 사전투표를 하는 비율이 높아지는 상황에서 각종 의혹을 불식하겠다는 취지다. 사전투표는 2013년 시범 도입됐는데, 2014년 지방선거 때 11.49%였던 사전투표율은 2018년 20.14%, 2022년 지방선거 때는 20.62%까지 높아졌다. 선관위는 지난 대선부터 투표소별 사전투표자 수를 1시간 단위로 공개하는데, 사전투표자수가 부풀려졌다는 일부 주장 때문이다.)

The NEC will expand the operation of the Fair Election Observation Group, first run in last year’s presidential election. Composed of figures from civic groups, professors, and other sectors, the observation group will monitor the entire election process on-site, including not only the voting and counting processes but also candidate registration, voter list preparation, submission of ballot return envelopes to the post office, and ballot box transport. Last year’s presidential election saw a group of 38 people operating in the Seoul, Incheon, and Gyeonggi metropolitan areas; this local election will expand it to 105 nationwide. (선관위는 지난해 대선 때 처음 운영한 공정선거참관단을 확대 운영한다. 시민단체 관계자, 교수 등 각계 인사로 구성된 참관단은 투·개표 과정뿐 아니라 후보자 등록, 선거인 명부 작성, 투표지 회송용 봉투 우체국 접수 절차 및 투표함 이송 등 선거 사무 전 과정을 현장에서 지켜볼 예정이다. 작년 대선 때 서울·인천·경기 등 수도권에서 38명 규모로 운영했는데 이번 지선에서는 전국(105명)으로 늘렸다.)

The NEC also plans to form its own ‘Voting Order Maintenance Special Response Team’ to prevent disturbances at advance polling stations. Among the 3,571 advance polling stations nationwide, 295 stations with many voters or where disruptions were expected during last year’s presidential election will have police officers deployed in teams of two. (선관위는 사전투표소에서 소란이 벌어지지 않도록 자체 ‘투표 질서 확립 특별 대응팀’도 구성하기로 했다. 전국 3571곳 사전투표소 가운데 지난 대선 당시 투표자가 많거나 소란이 예상되는 투표소 295곳에 2인 1조로 경찰이 배치된다.)

With official election campaigns starting on the 21st, the Democratic Party of Korea plans to actively encourage participation in advance voting. The People Power Party also announced that it has established a ‘Fair Election Safe Voting Committee’ and will conduct campaigns to encourage voting, including advance voting. (지난 21일 공식 선거운동이 시작된 가운데 더불어민주당은 사전투표 참여를 적극 장려할 계획이다. 국민의힘도 ‘공명선거 안심투표위원회’를 설치하고 사전투표를 포함해 투표 독려 운동을 벌인다고 밝혔다.)

Joint Planning by the National Election Commission and The Chosun Ilbo (중앙선거관리위원회·조선일보 공동 기획)

]]>

item.title: “We Should Help the President Since He’s Doing Well” vs. “Can’t Concentrate All Power on One Side” (“대통령 잘하니까 도와줘야쥬” vs “한쪽에 몰아줘서야 되겠슈”)
item.description:
“I’m still not sure yet. I’ll have to see when I go to the polling station.” (“아직 잘 몰라유. 투표장 가봐야 알쥬.”)

On the 21st, the first day of official campaigning for the June 3 local elections, many citizens encountered in Cheonan, Asan, Gongju, and Buyeo, South Chungcheong Province, said they had not yet decided who to vote for as governor of South Chungcheong. Kim Jeong-ja (79), who runs a clothing store at Gongju Sanseong Market, said, “They’re all the same,” adding, “Look around here—there’s no one in the market. I’ll pick a candidate who can really revive the economy.” In South Chungcheong, recent polls show a tight race between Park Su-hyeon of the Democratic Party and incumbent Governor Kim Tae-heum of the People Power Party, yet many residents remain undecided. “I’ll think it over a bit more and vote for whoever, whether ruling or opposition, helps us live well,” one said. <<> However, opinions among those intending to vote were sharply divided. Some said they would support the Democratic Party candidate to bolster President Lee Jae-myung, while others argued that checks on the government were necessary. <<> Lee Ji-yeon (35), a resident of Buldang New Town in Cheonan, said, “The president is doing a good job, isn’t he? I’m leaning toward the Democratic Party.” Lee Jeong-han (49), who works in electronic component manufacturing in the same area, added, “I think Park Su-hyeon can help the president.” Go Seon-ju (59), a private taxi driver in Cheonan, said, “I’m usually conservative, but the leadership of the People Power Party is so inept.” Choi (28), a worker met at Gongju University, said, “Still, since Park Su-hyeon is from Gongju, he’ll probably take better care of us.” <<> In contrast, Lee (68), a citizen met at Gongju Sanseong Market, said, “The president does well, sure. But can one side just take everything?” He added, “Although Park Su-hyeon was our district’s lawmaker, I’ll vote for Governor Kim Tae-heum this time for balance.” Choi (44), a merchant met in Buyeo, said, “With most regions turning Democratic, no matter how much I dislike it, I’ll vote for the People Power Party.” Kang Eun-cheol (61), who runs a restaurant in Dongnam-gu, Cheonan, said, “The government says it’s giving livelihood subsidies and high oil price support, but isn’t that all our taxes? I plan to back a conservative candidate.” <<> Support rates for candidates Park and Kim have been mixed in recent polls. Early in the campaign, Park led Kim by a double-digit margin outside the margin of error, but recently conservative voters have rallied, putting both candidates within the margin of error for first and second place. In a wireless ARS survey conducted by Realmeter for NewsPim on the 18th–19th and released on the 21st, Park had 43.5% and Kim had 43.9%. This was the first survey where Kim edged ahead of Park within the margin of error (±3.5 percentage points), recording a golden cross. In a phone interview survey by Korea Research for KBS conducted from the 16th–20th and released the same day, Park had 41% and Kim had 37%. However, with the undecided vote at around 10%, the election outcome in South Chungcheong—a traditional swing voter region—remains difficult to predict. <<> In Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang, where by-elections for the National Assembly are being held due to Park Su-hyeon’s gubernatorial bid, many citizens said they did not know who had even entered the race. Both Democratic candidate Kim Young-bin and People Power Party candidate Yoon Yong-geun are from the area, but are seen as unfamiliar faces. Recent polls show the two candidates neck and neck within the margin of error. Jeong Min-seo (22), a college student at Gongju University, said, “I don’t know the candidates well, but I dislike the authoritarian image of the conservative party, so I’ll vote for the Democratic candidate.” Jeon (54), a taxi driver in Buyeo, said, “I feel more drawn to Yoon Yong-geun of the People Power Party, since he’s from Buyeo.” Park (60), a Gongju High School graduate, said, “Both parties just parachuted in people no one knows from the center. I’ll vote for independent candidate Kim Hyeok-jong, who’s from Gongju.” (6.3 지방선거 공식선거운동 첫날인 지난 21일 충남 천안, 아산, 공주, 부여에서 만난 시민 상당수는 충남지사로 누구를 뽑을지 결정하지 못했다고 했다. 공주산성시장에서 옷 가게를 하는 김정자(79)씨는 “다 그놈이 그놈이유”라며 “여기 한번 보면 시장에 사람이 하나도 없슈. 경기 잘 살릴 수 있을 만한 후보로 뽑을겨”라고 했다. 충남은 최근 각종 여론조사에서 더불어민주당 박수현 후보와 현역 지사인 국민의힘 김태흠 후보가 초접전 양상을 보이고 있는 가운데, 실제 지역에선 아직 마음을 정하지 못했다는 부동층이 많았다. “조금 더 고민해보고 여(與)든 야(野)든 잘 먹고 잘살게 해주는 쪽에 투표하겠다”는 것이다.)

item.title: MBC Edits Out Only Kim Tae-heum’s Opening Remarks in TV Debate (MBC, TV토론회서 김태흠 모두 발언만 통편집)
item.description:
Daejeon MBC is facing controversy after airing a recorded TV debate for Chungcheongnam-do governor candidates, where only the opening remarks of People Power Party candidate Kim Tae-heum were deleted. Daejeon MBC apologized, calling it an "editing mistake," but the People Power Party argues that "editing TV debate footage itself violates the Public Official Election Act." (대전 MBC가 충남지사 후보 TV 토론회 녹화본을 방영할 때 국민의힘 김태흠 후보의 모두 발언만 삭제·방영해 논란이 되고 있다. 대전 MBC는 “편집상 실수”라고 사과했으나, 국민의힘은 “TV 토론 영상을 편집하는 것 자체가 공직선거법 위반”이라고 반발했다.)

Daejeon MBC recorded the debate featuring Chungcheongnam-do governor candidates at 3 PM on the 21st. The recorded footage was later broadcast on TV and YouTube at 9 PM that same day. However, while the opening remarks of Democratic Party candidate Park Soo-hyun were included, Kim’s opening remarks were cut out. (대전 MBC는 지난 21일 오후 3시에 충남지사 후보 초청 토론회를 녹화했다. 이후 녹화본을 그날 오후 9시에 TV와 유튜브로 중계했다. 그런데 더불어민주당 박수현 후보의 모두 발언은 나왔는데, 김 후보의 모두 발언은 삭제됐다.)

Kim’s campaign said on the 22nd, "The broadcaster arbitrarily edited a specific candidate's message and deprived voters of their opportunity to judge." The People Power Party’s media special committee called it "a blatant intervention in the election." The election law stipulates that when broadcasting facilities host or air debates or discussions, they must not edit the content. People Power Party representative Jang Dong-hyuk stated that day, "Editing and airing it that way was 200% intentional." (김 후보 캠프는 22일 “방송사가 자의적으로 특정 후보의 메시지를 편집하고 유권자의 판단 기회를 빼앗았다”고 했다. 국민의힘 미디어특위는 “노골적인 선거 개입”이라고 했다. 선거법에는 방송 시설이 대담·토론회를 개최·방송할 때는 내용을 편집해 방송하면 안 된다고 규정돼 있다. 국민의힘 장동혁 대표는 이날 “편집해서 내보낸 건 200% 의도적”이라고 했다.)

Daejeon MBC initially posted an apology on the morning of that day, stating it was "a mistake that occurred during the post-editing process of a single NG cut from the recording," but later that afternoon changed its explanation to "a mistake that occurred while correcting a caption error in Kim’s name." In response, Jang Dong-hyuk said on Facebook, "They even put out a false apology, and when challenged, they revised it? Trying to pass off ‘intent’ as a ‘mistake’ only ties their words in knots. It’s essentially a confession of a crime." The People Power Party filed a complaint against Daejeon MBC for violating the election law. Daejeon MBC re-aired the debate that evening, including Kim’s opening remarks. (대전 MBC는 이날 오전 사과문을 올리면서 “녹화 과정에서 생긴 NG컷 1개를 후편집하는 과정에서 생긴 실수”라고 했다가, 이날 오후엔 “김 후보 이름의 자막 오류를 바로잡는 과정에서 생긴 실수”라고 해명을 바꿨다. 그러자 장동혁 대표는 페이스북에서 “사과문까지 거짓말로 내놓고, 반박하니 수정? ‘고의’를 ‘실수’로 바꾸려니 말이 꼬인다. 사실상 범죄 자백”이라고 했다. 국민의힘은 대전 MBC를 선거법 위반으로 고발했다. 대전 MBC는 이날 저녁 김 후보 모두 발언을 넣은 토론회를 재방영했다.)

item.title: Park Geun-hye to Visit Daegu Chilseong Market with Choo Kyung-ho Today (박근혜, 오늘 추경호와 대구 칠성시장 찾는다)
item.description:
Former President Park Geun-hye will join Choo Kyung-ho, the People Power Party candidate for mayor of Daegu, for an on-site campaign at Chilseong Market in Daegu's Buk-gu district at 2 PM on the 23rd. It has been reported that requests for Park's campaign support have also been made in battleground areas for the June 3 local elections, including Busan and Chungcheong. (박근혜 전 대통령이 23일 오후 2시 국민의힘 추경호 대구시장 후보와 함께 대구 북구 칠성시장 현장 유세에 나선다. 6·3 지방선거 여야 격전지인 부산과 충청 등에서도 박 전 대통령 유세 지원 요청이 이어지는 것으로 알려졌다.)

Choo Kyung-ho's campaign team announced in a media notice on the 22nd that "former President Park plans to spend about 30 minutes with candidate Choo greeting merchants." This marks the first time Park, who was impeached and removed from office by the Constitutional Court in 2017, has taken to the campaign trail for an election candidate. Choo has been consistently elected in Daegu's Dalseong district, serving as a three-term lawmaker, while Park also won four consecutive National Assembly elections in the same Dalseong district. (추경호 후보 캠프는 22일 언론 공지에서 “박 전 대통령이 30분 정도 추 후보와 함께 상인들께 인사드릴 예정”이라고 했다. 지난 2017년 헌법재판소 탄핵 결정으로 파면된 박 전 대통령이 선거 출마자를 위해 현장 유세에 나서는 건 처음이다. 추 후보는 대구 달성에서 내리 당선돼 3선 의원을 지냈고, 박 전 대통령도 대구 달성에서만 네 번의 국회의원 선거에 당선됐다.)

Kim Boo-kyum, the Democratic Party candidate for mayor of Daegu, has reportedly made several official requests to visit former President Park recently but has received no specific response. Kim and Choo have been locked in a tight race according to recent polls. A ruling party official commented, "Kim also moved because he is aware of the public sentiment in Daegu that supports former President Park," adding, "As Park joins hands with Choo, the likelihood of conservative supporters rallying together has increased." (더불어민주당 김부겸 대구시장 후보도 최근 여러차례 박 전 대통령 예방을 공식 요청했지만 별다른 답을 듣지 못했다고 한다. 김 후보와 추 후보는 최근 여론조사에서 초접전 양상을 보이고 있다. 여권 관계자는 “김 후보도 박 전 대통령을 지지하는 대구 민심을 알기에 움직였던 것”이라며 “박 전 대통령이 추 후보와 손을 잡으면서 보수 지지층이 결집할 가능성이 커졌다”고 했다.)

In the opposition camp, it has been speculated that former President Park might hit the campaign trail next week to support Kim Tae-heum, the pro-Park faction candidate for governor of South Chungcheong Province, and Lee Jang-woo, candidate for mayor of Daejeon. Yoo Young-ha, a lawmaker from the People Power Party and a close aide to Park, told this newspaper, "It's true that there are many requests for campaign support, but nothing has been decided yet." (야권에선 박 전 대통령이 다음 주에 친박계 출신 김태흠 충남지사 후보와 이장우 대전시장 후보의 지원 유세를 나갈 가능성이 거론됐다. 박 전 대통령 최측근인 국민의힘 유영하 의원은 본지에 “유세 지원 요청이 많은 건 사실이지만 아직 결정된 것은 없다”고 했다.)
